sentences.en: This is the 99% Invisible Breakdown of The Power Broker.
sentences.zh: 这是《权力掮客》的 99% 隐形解析。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: And I'm Elliot Kalin.
sentences.zh: 我是埃利奥特·卡林。

sentences.en: Today is the day, my friends.
sentences.zh: 朋友们，这一天终于到了。

sentences.en: We are finishing the book.
sentences.zh: 我们要读完这本书了。

sentences.en: If you want to get precise, we're covering chapters 47 through 50, pages 1,082 through 1,162.
sentences.zh: 如果说得精确点，我们要讲的是第 47 到 50 章，第 1082 到 1162 页。

sentences.en: Now, we said last episode that we were not going to cover the notes section after the end of the book,
sentences.zh: 上一集我们说过，我们不会讲书末的注释部分，

sentences.en: but I guess you're just going to have to stick around to find out if I can keep that promise.
sentences.zh: 但我猜你得留下来听听，看我能不能信守这个承诺。

sentences.en: And later in this episode, our special guest is none other than Robert Caro himself.
sentences.zh: 在本集稍后，我们的特别嘉宾正是罗伯特·卡罗本人。

sentences.en: As we close the book and the series, we wanted to visit him again to get his perspective on the ending and the book's legacy.
sentences.zh: 随着我们合上这本书并结束这个系列，我们想再次拜访他，听听他对结局和这本书遗产的看法。

sentences.en: So on the last Power Broker Breakdown, we learned that Robert Moses tried to put a parking lot in the tavern in the green,
sentences.zh: 在上一期《权力掮客》解析中，我们了解到罗伯特·摩西试图在绿茵酒馆（Tavern on the Green）建一个停车场，

sentences.en: on the tavern in the green, in the tavern on the green, I'm not sure, one of those.
sentences.zh: 是在绿茵酒馆，还是在绿茵酒馆里，我也不确定，反正就是那儿。

sentences.en: Choose your own preposition.
sentences.zh: 介词随你选。

sentences.en: And ran against some moms who did not want it there.
sentences.zh: 他对抗了一些反对在那儿建停车场的妈妈们。

sentences.en: And it was kind of his first big New York newspaper defeat, which was a big deal,
sentences.zh: 这算是他在纽约报界遭遇的第一次重大挫败，意义非凡，

sentences.en: even though the crime itself was probably not as big a deal.
sentences.zh: 尽管这件事本身可能没那么严重。

sentences.en: And it sort of tarnished Moses' reputation for infallibility and incorruptibility.
sentences.zh: 它在某种程度上玷污了摩西“绝不犯错、绝不腐败”的名声。

sentences.en: The New York papers finally got off their duffs and started reporting on corruption in Moses' public housing projects.
sentences.zh: 纽约的报纸终于不再无动于衷，开始报道摩西公共住房项目中的腐败问题。

sentences.en: One of Moses' aides, the mustache, tries to pick a fight or does pick a fight with Joe Papp over allowing free Shakespeare in the park.
sentences.zh: 摩西的一位助手——那个留胡子的家伙——试图找乔·帕普的麻烦，或者说确实找了麻烦，因为帕普允许在公园里免费表演莎士比亚戏剧。

sentences.en: And this is another one of these just terrible just fumbles that damages Moses' reputation as the champion of the people.
sentences.zh: 这又是摩西犯下的一个极其糟糕的失误，损害了他作为“人民捍卫者”的声誉。

sentences.en: And the news media discovers some fairly sort of small ball scandals that are kind of unfair to Moses, as Caro sort of freely admits.
sentences.zh: 正如卡罗坦言，新闻媒体发现了一些相当琐碎的丑闻，这对摩西来说其实有点不公平。

sentences.en: But they do actually kind of stick to him for the first time.
sentences.zh: 但这些丑闻确实第一次让他陷入了困境。

sentences.en: And it encourages him to drop housing as one of the things he covers and resign his city jobs in order to become president of the 1964 World's Fair.
sentences.zh: 这促使他放弃了住房项目，并辞去了市政职务，转而担任 1964 年世界博览会的主席。

sentences.en: And then after he's lost those city jobs or resigned from those city jobs, the new governor, Nelson Rockefeller, calls Moses' bluff.
sentences.zh: 在他失去或辞去那些市政职务后，新任州长纳尔逊·洛克菲勒看穿了摩西的虚张声势。

sentences.en: They have a little bit of a fight.
sentences.zh: 他们发生了一点争执。

sentences.en: Moses decides to pull his old trick, threatens to resign from all of his state appointments.
sentences.zh: 摩西决定故技重施，威胁要辞去他所有的州政府职务。

sentences.en: And Rockefeller calls his bluff and he accepts the resignation for estate jobs.
sentences.zh: 而洛克菲勒没有上当，直接接受了他的辞呈。

sentences.en: And this is this is enormous self-own.
sentences.zh: 这简直是搬起石头砸自己的脚。

sentences.en: That would be the true beginning of the end of Moses.
sentences.zh: 那将是摩西走向终结的真正开始。

sentences.en: And so this is the last section that we will cover.
sentences.zh: 所以这是我们要讲的最后一部分。

sentences.en: However, I cannot believe it, we'll be covering pages 1082 to 1162, the final section of the book.
sentences.zh: 然而，我简直不敢相信，我们要讲的是第 1082 到 1162 页，也就是全书的最后一部分。

sentences.en: How are you feeling, Elliot Kalin?
sentences.zh: 埃利奥特·卡林，你感觉如何？

sentences.en: I, you know, I'm feeling both good and also I can't quite believe it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我感觉既好，又有点不敢相信。

sentences.en: Doing this show, reading this book has been such a part of my life for so long now, this year, that I kind of don't believe there are any other books.
sentences.zh: 做这个节目、读这本书已经成为我生活的一部分太久了，这一年来，我甚至觉得好像没有别的书存在了。

sentences.en: It's hard for me to imagine ever reading another book that's not this book.
sentences.zh: 我很难想象以后还会读除了这本书以外的其他书。

sentences.en: But, you know, maybe we'll talk at the end, maybe not about what a dream this has been and how much this has been such a wonderful thing to be a part of.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，也许我们最后会聊聊，也许不会，聊聊这段经历是多么梦幻，参与其中是多么美妙的一件事。

sentences.en: And I'm so excited about it.
sentences.zh: 我对此感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: But I don't know.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道。

sentences.en: We're not done yet.
sentences.zh: 我们还没结束呢。

sentences.en: Roman, do you think we're gonna be able to make it through the end?
sentences.zh: 罗曼，你觉得我们能坚持到最后吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, we're not done yet.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们还没结束。

sentences.en: So let's just start with chapter 47, the Great Fair.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们从第 47 章“伟大的博览会”开始吧。

sentences.en: What are we talking about here?
sentences.zh: 我们在这里讨论的是什么？

sentences.en: So that Great Fair is the aforementioned 1964 World's Fair.
sentences.zh: 那个“伟大的博览会”就是前面提到的 1964 年世界博览会。

sentences.en: So we're not gonna start right at 1964.
sentences.zh: 我们不会直接从 1964 年开始。

sentences.en: We're gonna start at 1959, which is when he begins running the fair.
sentences.zh: 我们要从 1959 年开始，那是他开始筹办博览会的时候。

sentences.en: But first, before we get into the section, I need to make a disclaimer.
sentences.zh: 但在进入这一部分之前，我需要做一个免责声明。

sentences.en: I am very partial to a specific New York World's Fair.
sentences.zh: 我对某一届纽约世界博览会有着特殊的偏爱。

sentences.en: And that fair is, of course, the 1939 World's Fair, the worlds of tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 那届博览会当然就是 1939 年的“明日世界”博览会。

sentences.en: Like, what a vision, what a dream of the future, bold, innovative, predictions that came true, some that didn't.
sentences.zh: 那样的愿景，那样的未来之梦，大胆、创新，有些预言成真了，有些没有。

sentences.en: My grandmother attended it as a girl and would tell me stories about it.
sentences.zh: 我祖母小时候参观过，还给我讲过关于它的故事。

sentences.en: It's where most people saw television for the first time in the New York area.
sentences.zh: 那是纽约地区大多数人第一次看到电视的地方。

sentences.en: It's a very major thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一件非常重大的事情。

sentences.en: And Robert Caro, throughout the book, is always taking digs at Grover Whelan, the chairman of that New York World's Fair of 1939, 1940,
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·卡罗在整本书中一直在挖苦 1939-1940 年纽约世界博览会的主席格罗弗·惠伦，

sentences.en: because Grover Whelan, admittedly, was kind of like an incompetent dandy who was just kind of like wasting money
sentences.zh: 因为格罗弗·惠伦公认是个无能的花花公子，只会浪费钱，

sentences.en: and was better known for like wearing a flower in his buttonhole all the time than actually doing things properly.
sentences.zh: 而且比起把事情做好，他更出名的是总是戴着一朵花在扣眼里。

sentences.en: And Caro was constantly talking about what a waste roll and what a failure that fair is.
sentences.zh: 卡罗一直在谈论那届博览会是多么浪费，多么失败。

sentences.en: And I just want to say the legacy of that fair is so much greater than the 64 World's Fair that Moses can oversee,
sentences.zh: 我只想说，那届博览会的遗产远比摩西负责的 64 年世博会要伟大得多，

sentences.en: which is, you know, has a certain lack of ambition.
sentences.zh: 那届博览会，你知道，缺乏某种雄心。

sentences.en: You're gonna find about it in this chapter.
sentences.zh: 你会在这一章里了解到的。

sentences.en: But if I am, I took some heat a number of episodes back for really going after Philly as the potential site of the United Nations.
sentences.zh: 不过，如果我——几集前我因为抨击费城作为联合国选址而遭到了一些批评。

sentences.en: If there's anyone here with a similar feeling about the 1964-65 World's Fair, I apologize.
sentences.zh: 如果这里有人对 1964-65 年世界博览会有类似的感觉，我表示歉意。

sentences.en: I just do not, it doesn't live up to the previous New York World's Fair.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得，它比不上上一届纽约世界博览会。

sentences.en: I just got to say it in my mind, you know.
sentences.zh: 我只是不得不说出我的想法，你知道的。

sentences.en: I think that's fair.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这很公平。

sentences.en: I think that's fair.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这很公平。

sentences.en: So this is another one of those things where to tell the whole story, he has to back up a little bit.
sentences.zh: 所以这又是那种为了讲清楚整个故事，他必须稍微倒叙一下的情况。

sentences.en: So Moses is running the fair from 1959 to 1965.
sentences.zh: 摩西从 1959 年到 1965 年负责运营博览会。

sentences.en: And so this is all during the initial planning stages.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都发生在最初的规划阶段。

sentences.en: And this is when he has the showdown with Rockefeller in 1962.
sentences.zh: 也就是他在 1962 年与洛克菲勒摊牌的时候。

sentences.en: So while the fair is ramping up, but before it opens, Moses is already in decline.
sentences.zh: 所以当博览会正在筹备但尚未开幕时，摩西已经在走下坡路了。

sentences.en: He's already lost all of his appointments.
sentences.zh: 他已经失去了所有的职位。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So he has left his city jobs in order to take on the presidency of the fair because there's so much more money.
sentences.zh: 他辞去了市政职务，转而担任博览会主席，因为那里的钱更多。

sentences.en: And there's going to be so much less controversy.
sentences.zh: 而且争议会少得多。

sentences.en: And this could be a source of power for him, as we'll see.
sentences.zh: 正如我们将看到的，这对他来说可能是一个权力来源。

sentences.en: But yeah, it's during that period in 1962, the year that Spider-Man first appears, that Rockefeller accepts his resignation.
sentences.zh: 但确实，就在 1962 年那个时期，也就是蜘蛛侠首次亮相的那一年，洛克菲勒接受了他的辞呈。

sentences.en: So yeah, this chapter straddles that somewhat.
sentences.zh: 所以这一章跨越了那个时间点。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the only thing he has left is he is still the head of the Triborough Authority.
sentences.zh: 他唯一剩下的职位就是继续担任三区大桥管理局的负责人。

sentences.en: And he's still the sort of, I can't remember the official title, but the liaison to the Federal Highway Commission.
sentences.zh: 他仍然是——我不记得正式头衔了，但他是联邦公路委员会的联络人。

sentences.en: He's the unofficial representative for the city and state on arterial highways.
sentences.zh: 他是城市和州在干线公路方面的非官方代表。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's very, it's always arterial.
sentences.zh: 总是干线公路。

sentences.en: There's blood on that, on that pavement.
sentences.zh: 那路面上沾满了鲜血。

sentences.en: So he's, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以他是，是的。

sentences.en: And so as, as we'll find out in this chapter, he's initially attracted to this fair because of the idea of the power that could come from it.
sentences.zh: 正如我们在这一章中会发现的，他最初被这个博览会吸引，是因为他看到了由此可能带来的权力。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's an issue right off the bat though.
sentences.zh: 不过一开始就有一个问题。

sentences.en: As Robert Caro is saying, the New York World's Fair of 1964 to 1965, it seems like a big undertaking.
sentences.zh: 正如罗伯特·卡罗所说，1964 到 1965 年的纽约世界博览会看起来是一项大工程。

sentences.en: But it's simply not large enough in scope to really engage Moses' intereSt.
sentences.zh: 但它的规模根本不足以真正引起摩西的兴趣。

sentences.en: This is a guy who's used to building things that will potentially last centuries.
sentences.zh: 这家伙习惯于建造可能存在几个世纪的东西。

sentences.en: And now his main job is going to be overseeing a public event with a built-in lifespan of two years.
sentences.zh: 而现在他的主要工作是监督一个注定只有两年寿命的公共活动。

sentences.en: And then once it's over, it's over.
sentences.zh: 一旦结束，就彻底结束了。

sentences.en: It's the point of these world's fairs.
sentences.zh: 这就是这些世界博览会的意义所在。

sentences.en: They're temporary.
sentences.zh: 它们是临时的。

sentences.en: They're transient.
sentences.zh: 它们是短暂的。

sentences.en: So Moses, he's not doing this because he loves fairs.
sentences.zh: 所以摩西做这个不是因为他热爱博览会。

sentences.en: He's not doing this because he just wants a job for a couple years.
sentences.zh: 他做这个也不是因为他只想找份工作干几年。

sentences.en: Everything with Moses is a step to the thing that Moses has always dreamed of.
sentences.zh: 摩西所做的一切都是为了实现他一直梦想的目标。

sentences.en: He has these dreams that come to him when he's young and he's spending decades trying to get them.
sentences.zh: 他年轻时就有这些梦想，并花了数十年时间去追求它们。

sentences.en: And in this case, he says, I can use this to finally clear and improve the land for what will one day be known in his mind as Robert Moses Park,
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，他说，我可以利用这个机会最终清理并改善这片土地，在他心中，这里终有一天会被称为“罗伯特·摩西公园”，

sentences.en: this chain of parks going through Queens in the former marshland of Flushing Meadows, Queens, that in his mind will be the biggest public parks,
sentences.zh: 这一连串穿过皇后区法拉盛草甸前沼泽地的公园，在他看来将成为世界上最大、

sentences.en: the best public parks ever in the world.
sentences.zh: 最好的公共公园。

sentences.en: And he's been dreaming about this for a long time.
sentences.zh: 他已经为此梦想了很久。

sentences.en: And this is another one of his things where you have to admire the visionary quality of it a little bit because when he first started streaming about this,
sentences.zh: 这又是他的一件事，你不得不稍微钦佩一下他的远见，因为当他最初开始梦想这个时，

sentences.en: Flushing Meadows is literally an enormous garbage and ash dump.
sentences.zh: 法拉盛草甸简直就是一个巨大的垃圾和灰烬堆。

sentences.en: There's so many great names in this book.
sentences.zh: 这本书里有好多很棒的名字。

sentences.en: And apparently the contractor running this was named Fish Hooks McCarthy.
sentences.zh: 显然，负责运营这个垃圾场的承包商名叫“鱼钩”麦卡锡。

sentences.en: It's like that's someone who like Batman beats up for information about where the penguin is.
sentences.zh: 听起来就像是蝙蝠侠为了打听企鹅人在哪儿而痛扁的那种人。

sentences.en: But it was this enormous, enormous garbage dump.
sentences.zh: 但这确实是一个巨大、巨大的垃圾场。

sentences.en: This is where all of Brooklyn's garbage was taken and burned.
sentences.zh: 布鲁克林所有的垃圾都被运到这里焚烧。

sentences.en: And there was a local landmark, which was a hundred foot tall hill of garbage called Mount Corona because this was the Corona part of Queens.
sentences.zh: 那里还有一个当地地标，一座 100 英尺高的垃圾山，被称为“科罗纳山”，因为这是皇后区的科罗纳地区。

sentences.en: This is a place that just detail of is it's so infested with vermin that there's a community of shanty dwellers who live in this dump and make a living trapping the rats and other mammals and selling their fur to the furriers of New York City.
sentences.zh: 这个地方细节多到令人发指，到处都是害虫，甚至有一个棚户区居民社区住在这个垃圾场里，靠捕捉老鼠和其他哺乳动物，把皮毛卖给纽约市的皮草商为生。

sentences.en: And like Fitzgerald describes this in The Great Gatsby.
sentences.zh: 菲茨杰拉德在《了不起的盖茨比》中也描述过这一点。

sentences.en: It's just this nightmarish wasteland, this just horrible, the most dystopian city section that you can imagine.
sentences.zh: 这简直是一片噩梦般的荒原，你能想象到的最可怕、最反乌托邦的城市区域。

sentences.en: But Robert Moses, in true Moses style, like he sees what could be the most amazing park in the history of New York.
sentences.zh: 但罗伯特·摩西，以典型的摩西风格，他看到了这里可能成为纽约历史上最令人惊叹的公园。

sentences.en: And in fact, he you know, it's a it's a bigger area than Central Park.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你知道，它的面积比中央公园还要大。

sentences.en: It's one thousand three hundred and forty six acres.
sentences.zh: 它有一千三百四十六英亩。

sentences.en: It is actually in the geographic center of New York when you include all the boroughs and it could just be this amazing thing.
sentences.zh: 如果你把所有行政区都算上，它实际上位于纽约的地理中心，这本可以成为一个了不起的地方。

sentences.en: And the beginning of the problem with him running the World's Fair is that the World's Fair is trying to exist as this temporary like explosion of creativity of the moment of now,
sentences.zh: 他经营世博会问题的开端在于，世博会试图作为一种临时的、当下的、创造力的爆发而存在，

sentences.en: maybe a little bit of the future.
sentences.zh: 也许带有一点点未来感。

sentences.en: And it it has, you know, temporary buildings that has, you know, people coming in, you know, just for those two years.
sentences.zh: 它有临时的建筑，有只在那两年里来参观的人。

sentences.en: He's just so uninterested in that.
sentences.zh: 他对此毫无兴趣。

sentences.en: And he wants to create this park that will stand for the ages.
sentences.zh: 他想创造一个能经受住时间考验的公园。

sentences.en: And it just is immediately that's the that's the source of all the problems when it comes to him running the fair.
sentences.zh: 这立刻就成了他经营博览会时所有问题的根源。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And this is something that Moses is so fixated on because he's wanted it for many years.
sentences.zh: 这是摩西非常执着的事情，因为他已经渴望多年了。

sentences.en: And Carol goes into these previous times where it seems like Moses was going to be able to get a little bit closer to building this enormous string of parks.
sentences.zh: 卡罗回顾了之前的几次机会，当时摩西似乎能够更接近于建造这一连串巨大的公园。

sentences.en: But each time it doesn't quite work out.
sentences.zh: 但每次都没有成功。

sentences.en: The thirty nine, forty World's Fair.
sentences.zh: 39、40 年的世界博览会。

sentences.en: Remember, that's 15 years into Moses being the parks guy.
sentences.zh: 记住，那是摩西担任公园负责人的第 15 年。

sentences.en: And so he's like, great, we'll put the thirty nine World's Fair here and we'll clean it up with the profits in the fair that'll make this park.

sentences.en: But of course, that that fair makes no profits.

sentences.zh: 它从来不赚钱。

sentences.zh: 而且需求太大了，要花很多钱。

sentences.zh: 卡罗提到他们需要安装一套新的排水系统，因为沼泽地里会有泥浪，会撕裂他们安装在沼泽里的木制地基和桩基。

sentences.en: Like it's so it's such a terrible place to build anything.
sentences.zh: 这地方简直太糟糕了，不适合建造任何东西。

sentences.en: But that park is a disaster.
sentences.zh: 但那个公园是个灾难。

sentences.en: Later on, Moses is like, maybe this could be the site for the U.N.
sentences.zh: 后来，摩西想，也许这里可以作为联合国总部的选址。

sentences.en: headquarters.
sentences.zh: 他一直在寻找任何机会来翻新这片土地。

sentences.en: Like he's looking for any opportunity to refurbish this land.
sentences.zh: 1951 年，皇后区需要一套新的雨水下水道系统，摩西把它安在了他为了建公园所需要的区域。

sentences.en: In 1951, Queens needs a new storm sewer system and Moses gets it put in the area he would need it for his parks to make them.
sentences.zh: 所以到了 1959 年，人们开始谈论举办新的世界博览会。

sentences.en: And so by 1959, people are talking about a new World's Fair.
sentences.zh: 他想，如果我是这届世博会的主席，我终于可以为这些公园，为罗伯特·摩西公园打下坚实的基础了。

sentences.en: He's like, if I'm the president of this World's Fair, I can finally lay the foundation properly for these parks, for Robert Moses Park.
sentences.zh: 卡罗在脚注中指出了这一点。

sentences.en: And this is something that in a footnote Carol points out.
sentences.zh: 他说，另一个证据表明摩西真正考虑的是未来的公园而不是博览会，那就是当交通系统说，嘿，

sentences.zh: 我们能不能修一条地铁延长线通往博览会现场，带来更多买票的人？

sentences.en: can we make a subway extension to go to the fair site and bring more people who can pay for tickets?
sentences.zh: 他对此并不感兴趣。

sentences.en: He goes, no, because he does not want low income people taking the subway to that park.
sentences.zh: 他说不，因为他不想让低收入人群坐地铁去那个公园。

sentences.en: That's not interested.
sentences.zh: 那可没意思。

sentences.en: Truly the Moses way.
sentences.zh: 这确实是摩西的作风。

sentences.en: But Carol also points out that this is one of those things after the housing debacle and all these sort of little crises that are sort of plaguing Moses.
sentences.zh: 但卡罗尔也指出，在住房惨败和一系列困扰摩西的小危机之后，这又是那种典型的事情。

sentences.en: Attaching himself to the fair is just a good PR move.
sentences.zh: 把自己和世博会捆绑在一起，只是一个很好的公关手段。

sentences.en: Like he's he's he's coming back to being the parks guy.
sentences.zh: 就像他又要回归做那个“公园先生”了。

sentences.en: All fun.
sentences.zh: 全是娱乐。

sentences.en: Jones Beach, putting a park in your neighborhood and we're going to put on the fair.
sentences.zh: 琼斯海滩，在你的社区建个公园，然后我们还要举办世博会。

sentences.en: And it's just a lot of potential popularity and power.
sentences.zh: 这蕴含着巨大的潜在人气和权力。

sentences.en: And it also is a lot of money that comes in that he can distribute, you know, to contractors and to people like building things that are necessary for the fair.
sentences.zh: 而且这也意味着会有大笔资金流入，他可以把这些钱分发给承包商，以及那些为世博会建设必要设施的人。

sentences.en: But pavilions and walkways and landscaping, all the types of things that he knows how to spend that kind of money.
sentences.zh: 还有展馆、步道和景观设计，这些都是他擅长花钱的地方。

sentences.en: And he knows all the people that he can give that money to.
sentences.zh: 而且他认识所有能拿到这笔钱的人。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And just to give you an idea of how much money he has to throw around in the fair's first cost estimate, there's a line of that just says miscellaneous, fifty five million dollars.
sentences.zh: 为了让你了解他有多少钱可以挥霍，在世博会的初步成本估算中，有一行写着“杂项”，金额是五千五百万美元。

sentences.en: It's like, all right, it's a pretty big bucket.
sentences.zh: 就像是，好吧，这真是一个巨大的钱袋子。

sentences.en: Just throw whatever in.
sentences.zh: 随便往里扔什么都行。

sentences.en: But so if you're a politically connected contractor, you will get a contract from Moses, a very generous contract.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是一个有政治背景的承包商，你就能从摩西那里得到一份合同，一份非常慷慨的合同。

sentences.en: And you'll have permission to kind of gouge the exhibitors with their high prices.
sentences.zh: 而且你还会获准以高价去宰那些参展商。

sentences.en: The exhibitors at the fair, they have to get insurance from one specific insurance company that's politically connected.
sentences.zh: 世博会的参展商必须从一家特定的、有政治背景的保险公司购买保险。

sentences.en: And it annoys Mayor Wagner, who's still mayor at the time, because these contracts are going to his political rivals.
sentences.zh: 这让当时的市长瓦格纳很恼火，因为这些合同都流向了他的政治对手。

sentences.en: But he is so obsessed with never asking Moses for a favor because that would give Moses leverage over him that he just refuses to ask, hey, can those contracts go to my guys?
sentences.zh: 但他太执着于绝不向摩西求情，因为那样会给摩西留下把柄，所以他拒绝开口问：“嘿，那些合同能给我的人吗？”

sentences.en: He's just – and Moses is like, all he has to do is ask.
sentences.zh: 他只是——而摩西的态度是，他只需要开口就行。

sentences.en: All he's got to do is ask me.
sentences.zh: 他只要开口求我就行了。

sentences.en: And Wagner's like, no, never.
sentences.zh: 而瓦格纳的态度是，不，绝不。

sentences.en: I'll never give you that inch.
sentences.zh: 我绝不会让你占那一点便宜。

sentences.en: And Moses starts to brag and talk about how so much money is coming in from advance ticket sales, which means that the contractors are like, great, we can charge even more money.
sentences.zh: 摩西开始吹嘘预售票带来了多少钱，这意味着承包商们觉得太棒了，我们可以收更多的钱。

sentences.en: And Moses, he's just spending so lavishly because he expects this fair to be a huge success.
sentences.zh: 摩西花钱大手大脚，因为他预计这次世博会会大获成功。

sentences.en: And he's doing very tri-bro type spending things.
sentences.zh: 他正在做非常“三桥”风格的消费行为。

sentences.en: For security for the fair, you just need kind of security guards.
sentences.zh: 世博会的安保工作，你只需要普通的保安就行了。

sentences.en: But he hires this platoon of uniformed Pinkerton agents who wear white gloves and white ascots, and they're like an honor guard at the fair headquarters.
sentences.zh: 但他雇佣了一整排穿制服的平克顿特工，他们戴着白手套和白色领巾，就像世博会总部的仪仗队一样。

sentences.en: And all of his cronies get great jobs.
sentences.zh: 他所有的亲信都得到了好差事。

sentences.en: They all have expense accounts, limousines, chauffeurs.
sentences.zh: 他们都有差旅费、豪华轿车和专职司机。

sentences.en: There's chefs for VIP guests.
sentences.zh: 还有专门为贵宾服务的厨师。

sentences.en: If you know anyone who knows Moses, you get in for free.
sentences.zh: 如果你认识任何认识摩西的人，你就能免费入场。

sentences.en: Again, his whole Yale graduating class gets the royal treatment at the fair because the fair is going to pay for it.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，他整个耶鲁大学的同学在世博会上都享受到了皇室般的待遇，因为世博会会为此买单。

sentences.en: Moses is like, I'm used to spending a lot of money at tri-bro just to show off, just to win people over.
sentences.zh: 摩西心想，我在三桥时就习惯了花大钱来炫耀，来赢得人心。

sentences.en: I can do that here too.
sentences.zh: 在这里我也能这么做。

sentences.en: And so in the first year, the fair corporation ends up spending twice its original budget.
sentences.zh: 所以第一年，世博会公司最终花费了最初预算的两倍。

sentences.en: Like they're so vastly overspending.
sentences.zh: 他们简直是严重超支。

sentences.en: It's ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 太荒谬了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And it's sort of confusing because up to that point in his career, he hasn't really had a tendency to spend money he didn't have.
sentences.zh: 这有点令人困惑，因为在他职业生涯的那个阶段之前，他并没有花自己没有的钱的习惯。

sentences.en: Like, you know, it just was pouring into such an extent that he could spend money and do these lavish things.
sentences.zh: 你知道，钱源源不断地涌入，以至于他可以随意挥霍，做这些奢侈的事情。

sentences.en: But then, you know, but the nickels and dimes were coming at such an extent that it didn't it didn't really matter.
sentences.zh: 但后来，你知道，那些零钱进账的规模已经大到根本无所谓了。

sentences.en: It just kind of reminds me of just like of, you know, just being a rich kid, not knowing the value of money potentially, you know,
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了一个富家子弟，可能根本不知道钱的价值，你知道，

sentences.en: because because he's gotten so much pouring in all the time.
sentences.zh: 因为他一直有源源不断的钱涌入。

sentences.en: But at this point, you know, he's spending money that he doesn't have yet.
sentences.zh: 但在这一点上，他花的是他还没赚到的钱。

sentences.en: And it's it's really something it's sort of a new turn for him.
sentences.zh: 这确实有点意思，对他来说是一个新的转折。

sentences.en: I think the rich kid analogy is a good one because he's just so used to being at the head of a massively successful money making organization that he doesn't quite see yet that it's not that he has the golden touch.
sentences.zh: 我认为富家子弟的比喻很贴切，因为他太习惯于领导一个极其成功的赚钱组织，以至于他还没意识到，并不是他拥有点石成金的魔力。

sentences.en: And something Carol will get to later in the chapter is talking about how a road or a bridge is something people have to take.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔在书的后面会提到，公路或桥梁是人们必须使用的东西。

sentences.en: Like they need to use it to get where they're going.
sentences.zh: 就像他们需要用它去往目的地一样。

sentences.en: Whereas a fair, you don't need to go to a fair like that is that is an entertainment choice.
sentences.zh: 而世博会，你不需要去参加，那是一种娱乐选择。

sentences.en: And so Moses, I think, is used to building something and having people need to pay him for it, whether they like it or not.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为摩西习惯了建造一些东西，然后让人们无论喜不喜欢都必须为之付费。

sentences.en: And so I think he's just like, I'm making this thing.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他只是觉得，我在造这个东西。

sentences.en: Whatever I make makes a ton of money.
sentences.zh: 我造的任何东西都能赚大钱。

sentences.en: This is going to make a ton of money.
sentences.zh: 这个也能赚大钱。

sentences.en: Let's spend that money.
sentences.zh: 让我们把钱花出去。

sentences.en: It's going to be fine.
sentences.zh: 会没事的。

sentences.en: Let's do it.
sentences.zh: 干吧。

sentences.en: And as Carol says, he says, the World's Fair gave Robert Moses a billion dollars to spend on power and he got his money's worth.
sentences.zh: 正如卡罗尔所说，他说：“世博会给了罗伯特·摩西十亿美元来挥霍权力，他确实物有所值。”

sentences.en: And this power means that he can have the city pouring money in, too.
sentences.zh: 这种权力意味着他也能让市政府源源不断地投入资金。

sentences.en: And eventually the city sinks over $60 million into the fair.
sentences.zh: 最终，市政府在世博会上投入了超过六千万美元。

sentences.en: And this is a fair that was designed to bring money into the city.
sentences.zh: 而这本是一个旨在为城市带来收入的世博会。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the city is spending tens of billions of dollars on it.
sentences.zh: 而市政府却在上面花费了数百亿美元。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But the good thing, Rowan, at least this fair is going to make him popular again.
sentences.zh: 但好消息是，罗恩，至少这次世博会能让他重新受欢迎。

sentences.en: But it doesn't.
sentences.zh: 但并没有。

sentences.en: I mean, it sort of ruined his reputation even more.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这反而让他的名声更臭了。

sentences.en: And it's basically his fault.
sentences.zh: 而且这基本上是他的错。

sentences.en: Like he does not run the fair very well.
sentences.zh: 他经营世博会的方式并不好。

sentences.en: And and Carol sort of supposes that this is kind of similar to when the first park expansion happened in the cities when he was really going gangbusters.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔推测，这有点类似于他刚开始在城市进行公园扩建时，那时他正干得热火朝天。

sentences.en: Like he just was pulled in too many directions.
sentences.zh: 他当时被太多事情牵扯了精力。

sentences.en: And even though I mean, we've talked about like this is the time where he straddled having estate jobs and leaving estate jobs during the ramp up to the fair.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们谈到过，这是他在世博会筹备期间，同时兼顾州政府工作和离开州政府工作的时期。

sentences.en: He was building that dam that nobody cares about.
sentences.zh: 他当时在建那个没人关心的水坝。

sentences.en: No one wants to hear about ever.
sentences.zh: 没人想听关于它的事。

sentences.en: Don't even tell me about it.
sentences.zh: 别跟我提那个。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: You know, he was doing all these state jobs and he did not have the expertise to to know like how what would be appealing to people.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他当时在做所有这些州政府的工作，他没有专业知识去了解什么对人们有吸引力。

sentences.en: He did not have the finesse when it comes to getting those, you know, buy in from the international community to sort of buy into these pavilions and sponsor them.
sentences.zh: 在获得国际社会的认可，让他们参与并赞助这些展馆方面，他缺乏技巧。

sentences.en: He didn't have a lot of sponsors from, you know, like companies.
sentences.zh: 他没有得到很多来自公司的赞助。

sentences.en: I mean, it ended up not being a very international world's fair and mostly devoted to Ford, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它最终并没有成为一个非常国际化的世博会，我猜大部分都贡献给了福特公司。

sentences.en: I mean, the main legacy of the fair is the I think great moments with Mr. Lincoln.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，世博会的主要遗产我认为是《与林肯先生的伟大时刻》。

sentences.en: The attraction at Disneyland that that Walt Disney designed for for this fair.
sentences.zh: 那是华特·迪士尼为这次世博会设计的迪士尼乐园景点。

sentences.en: But but you're right.
sentences.zh: 但你是对的。

sentences.en: He's he's doing all these jobs that normally would be a one huge job for a person.
sentences.zh: 他同时在做所有这些工作，而这些工作通常一个人做一项就够累了。

sentences.en: And he's still he's still overseeing the dam.
sentences.zh: 他仍然在监督水坝工程。

sentences.en: He's still overseeing state park expansion.
sentences.zh: 他仍然在监督州立公园的扩建。

sentences.en: He's still seeing he's still trying to get the Fire Island Highway Expressway built.
sentences.zh: 他仍然在试图建造火岛公路高速公路。

sentences.en: And he just doesn't know much about fairs.
sentences.zh: 而且他对世博会知之甚少。

sentences.en: And he's so tied to his group of people, his cronies that he knows will say yes to him, that he hires them and they don't know anything about fairs either.
sentences.zh: 他太依赖他那群亲信了，他知道他们会对他言听计从，所以他雇用了他们，而他们对世博会也一窍不通。

sentences.en: And Carol just talks about partly Moses just didn't care that much.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔提到，部分原因是摩西根本不在乎。

sentences.en: Like the fair is a means to an end for him.
sentences.zh: 世博会对他来说只是达到目的的一种手段。

sentences.en: And that end is contradictory to the fair.
sentences.zh: 而那个目的与世博会本身是矛盾的。

sentences.en: So it'll be better for the park if everything's built cheaply so you can tear it down.
sentences.zh: 所以如果一切都建得很廉价，以后拆除时对公园会更好。

sentences.en: It's better for the park if you can charge higher rents so that you can have that money later for building the park.
sentences.zh: 如果你能收取更高的租金，以后有钱建公园，这对公园来说更好。

sentences.en: But it but it scares off exhibitors.
sentences.zh: 但这会吓跑参展商。

sentences.en: He doesn't want to have like a big master plan for the fair because it might get in the way of his later plans for the park.
sentences.zh: 他不想为世博会制定一个宏大的总体规划，因为这可能会妨碍他以后对公园的规划。

sentences.en: And like you're saying, he's used to being arrogant in his little pond of the New York state area.
sentences.zh: 就像你说的，他习惯了在纽约州这个小池塘里作威作福。

sentences.en: And now he's being arrogant on the world stage.
sentences.zh: 现在他要在世界舞台上傲慢自大了。

sentences.en: And like other he pisses off the Bureau of International Expositions, which is a real organization, and they tell their members, don't do this fair.
sentences.zh: 他惹恼了国际展览局，那是一个真正的组织，他们告诉成员们：不要参加这个世博会。

sentences.en: So it means Britain, Italy, France, you know, big name countries are not going to be there.
sentences.zh: 这意味着英国、意大利、法国，你知道，那些大国都不会参加。

sentences.en: And of those Western European powers, only Spain is like, no, we're going to be in this fair.
sentences.zh: 在那些西欧大国中，只有西班牙说：不，我们要参加这个世博会。

sentences.en: So like they have Franco's Spain, I guess, you know, represented at the fair, but not a lot of and not a lot of the rest of the world.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，佛朗哥时期的西班牙在世博会上有了代表，但世界上其他大部分国家都没有参加。

sentences.en: And Carol says, basically, only six major nations appeared at this so-called World's Fair, Indonesia, Egypt, India, Japan, Mexico and Pakistan, which are great countries.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔说，基本上只有六个主要国家出现在这个所谓的世博会上：印度尼西亚、埃及、印度、日本、墨西哥和巴基斯坦，这些都是伟大的国家。

sentences.en: Those are all great countries.
sentences.zh: 那些都是伟大的国家。

sentences.en: I'd like to go to all of them.
sentences.zh: 我想去所有这些地方。

sentences.en: But but like you want a World's Fair to have a lot more more of the world represented.
sentences.zh: 但你希望世博会有更多世界各地的代表参加。

sentences.en: I mean, and and this this idea of his just sort of being so against these temporary pavilions and only interested in things that would that he could repurpose later.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他这种反对临时展馆，只对以后能重新利用的东西感兴趣的想法……

sentences.en: And the thing is, when it comes to fairs like this, the only the only equivalent I've ever been to is the is the Venice Biennale.
sentences.zh: 问题是，说到这种世博会，我唯一去过的类似活动是威尼斯双年展。

sentences.en: The exhibits I was not all that wowed by when I saw it.
sentences.zh: 我看到那些展品时并没有感到特别惊艳。

sentences.en: But wow.
sentences.zh: 但是，哇。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Take that Venice shots fired.
sentences.zh: 收下吧，威尼斯，被开火了。

sentences.en: Now all the Venetians have to come after Roman.
sentences.zh: 现在所有的威尼斯人都要来找罗曼的麻烦了。

sentences.en: I'm just saying.
sentences.zh: 我只是随口一说。

sentences.en: But the pavilions were amazing.
sentences.zh: 但那些展馆太棒了。

sentences.en: Like these these buildings that that were, you know, just like the United States and Hungary and all these places had the had their own buildings that they, you know,
sentences.zh: 就像那些建筑，你知道，就像美国、匈牙利和所有这些地方都有自己的建筑，他们，你知道，

sentences.en: would fill every two years with a new exhibit related to architecture and design.
sentences.zh: 每两年都会填入与建筑和设计相关的新展品。

sentences.en: And the buildings themselves were so stunning.
sentences.zh: 建筑本身就非常令人惊叹。

sentences.en: Like this is a real like missed opportunity because you could have had an amazing set of pavilions that outlasted the fair potentially.
sentences.zh: 这真是一个错失的机会，因为你本可以拥有一组令人惊叹的展馆，它们可能比世博会本身存在得更久。

sentences.en: Anyway, I love the pavilions at the at the Venice Biennale.
sentences.zh: 总之，我喜欢威尼斯双年展的展馆。

sentences.en: So I mean, yeah, someday I hope to go someday.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，希望有一天我能去看看。

sentences.en: I hope to see it.
sentences.zh: 我希望能看到它。

sentences.en: So the I mean,
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，

sentences.en: I wonder if the people of Rome are at all offended that you're going on and about Venice and your name is literally Roman and you're not you're not talking about them.
sentences.zh: 我不知道罗马人是否会因为你一直在谈论威尼斯而感到被冒犯，而且你的名字叫罗曼，你却根本不提他们。

sentences.en: But there are and there are some structures left from this 64 World's Fair in in that part.
sentences.zh: 但在那个区域，确实还留有一些64年世博会的建筑。

sentences.en: The Unisphere as seen in Men in Black, the movie like that's that's from there.
sentences.zh: 电影《黑衣人》里看到的那个地球仪，就是从那里来的。

sentences.en: And but when you walk around that area, at least when I did years ago, when I still live in New York, it feels like you are in a place of like ruins, like stuff that are I mean,
sentences.zh: 但当你走在那个区域时，至少我几年前还在纽约住的时候，感觉就像身处废墟之中，那些东西，我的意思是，

sentences.en: there's they've cleaned it up.
sentences.zh: 他们已经清理过了。

sentences.en: The park is nicely cleaned up and there's still some things left and there's some neat museum stuff there.
sentences.zh: 公园清理得很干净，还有一些东西留着，那里还有一些不错的博物馆设施。

sentences.en: But you do feel like the things that are left over mostly from that fair have not been we're not necessarily meant to stay and have not been kept up particularly amazingly.
sentences.zh: 但你确实觉得剩下的东西大多不是为了长久保存而建的，也没有得到特别好的维护。

sentences.en: And we're not built with an eye towards this will last for a long time.
sentences.zh: 而且建造时也没有考虑到“这会持续很久”这一点。

sentences.en: And the funny thing about fairs is like I think that when it comes to these types of events,
sentences.zh: 关于世博会，有趣的一点是，我认为当涉及到这类活动时，

sentences.en: this is the type of thing where I think people in the press are kind of looking for a disaster.
sentences.zh: 这是那种我认为媒体正在寻找灾难的类型。

sentences.en: You know, I mean, they they have this sort of they have a little bit.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的意思是，他们确实有一点。

sentences.en: There's like blood in the water and you can feel it when people aren't excited about a thing.
sentences.zh: 就像闻到了血腥味，当人们对某件事不兴奋时，你能感觉到。

sentences.en: And so the press who has already started, he started to lose with the previous fights that we've talked about.
sentences.zh: 所以媒体，他已经开始在我们之前谈论的那些斗争中失利了。

sentences.en: They're really picking on him during this time period.
sentences.zh: 在这段时间里，他们真的在找他的茬。

sentences.en: And he is just not used to this.
sentences.zh: 而他对此并不习惯。

sentences.en: No, and he takes the bait every time instead of just letting the bad press roll over him.
sentences.zh: 不，他每次都上钩，而不是让负面新闻随风而去。

sentences.en: He always gets mad and attacks them again.
sentences.zh: 他总是很生气，然后再次攻击他们。

sentences.en: And he's he's and this is when the press is they're ready to go after him.
sentences.zh: 而且这是媒体准备好攻击他的时候。

sentences.en: Even The New York Times is criticizing his work at this point.
sentences.zh: 甚至连《纽约时报》此时都在批评他的工作。

sentences.en: And they've stopped automatically printing every letter he writes them, which he's very insulted by.
sentences.zh: 而且他们已经停止自动刊登他写的每一封信了，这让他感到非常受辱。

sentences.en: But he writes this an article for the Sunday Times magazine about the press.
sentences.zh: 但他为《星期日泰晤士报》杂志写了一篇关于媒体的文章。

sentences.en: And there's I just I love reading his writing.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢读他写的文字。

sentences.en: So I just want to read you an excerpt where it says there is a notable tendency in the press to cut officials to one size in a sort of bed of procrustes to put on spiked shoes and cleats and to jump on victims when they are down like a mob at the fights shouting with such glee when an aging champion is beaten up and dethroned.
sentences.zh: 所以我只想读给你一段摘录，上面写着：“媒体中有一种显著的倾向，就是把官员们削足适履，穿上带钉的鞋子，当受害者倒下时，就像斗殴现场的暴徒一样跳上去，当一位老去的冠军被击败并被废黜时，他们会欢呼雀跃。”

sentences.en: And there's also a potent minority of jackals and vultures who hang around the outskirts and hover over trouble spots to discover a wound or blood and then close in or swoop down for the kill.
sentences.zh: “还有一小撮强大的豺狼和秃鹫，徘徊在边缘，盘旋在麻烦地带，寻找伤口或血迹，然后围拢或俯冲下来进行杀戮。”

sentences.en: It's like this is not going to win you the press.
sentences.zh: 这就像是，这可赢不来媒体的支持。

sentences.en: The press is not going to be won over by this.
sentences.zh: 媒体是不会被这种手段收买的。

sentences.en: And that like and then the press is like, oh, you're attacking me.
sentences.zh: 然后媒体就会觉得，哦，你在攻击我。

sentences.en: We'll attack you like it's a real, you know, F me, F you.
sentences.zh: 我们会像对待真正的敌人一样攻击你，你知道的，就是那种互相敌视的关系。

sentences.en: And so they they do this by revealing things he's lying about about the fair's operations, especially this post reporter named Joe Conn.
sentences.zh: 所以他们通过揭露他在世博会运营上的谎言来反击，尤其是这位名叫乔·康恩的《邮报》记者。

sentences.en: He starts reporting about how there's like sweetheart vendor deals of the types that that he had done in his parks before.
sentences.zh: 他开始报道世博会存在那种他以前在公园项目里搞过的“裙带关系”供应商交易。

sentences.en: And then he literally starts checking with countries and organizations that have been announced as being involved in the fair to see if they're actually doing it.
sentences.zh: 然后他真的开始向那些被宣布参与世博会的国家和组织核实，看看他们是否真的会参加。

sentences.en: And I love this quote from him that that Kara has.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢卡拉引用的他的一句话。

sentences.en: He goes, nobody in his right mind would assign me to a thing like this.
sentences.zh: 他说，没脑子的人才会派我去做这种事。

sentences.en: It took too much time.
sentences.zh: 这太花时间了。

sentences.en: So I was doing it all on my own at the same time that I was doing my regular assignments.
sentences.zh: 所以我是在做本职工作的同时，独自一人完成这些调查的。

sentences.en: I was doing it all myself.
sentences.zh: 全是我一个人干的。

sentences.en: God, I remember now I never told anyone what I was doing.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我现在才想起来，我当时从没告诉过任何人我在做什么。

sentences.en: A terrible, awful job.
sentences.zh: 一份糟糕透顶的工作。

sentences.en: And like he's literally just calling states and being like, are you going to have something at the World's Fair?
sentences.zh: 他真的就是给各个国家打电话，问他们：“你们要在世博会上展出东西吗？”

sentences.en: Who do I talk to about that?
sentences.zh: “我该找谁谈这个？”

sentences.en: Oh, you're not.
sentences.zh: “哦，你们不参加啊。”

sentences.en: Is Switzerland, are you going to have something at the World's Fair?
sentences.zh: “瑞士，你们要在世博会上展出东西吗？”

sentences.en: You're not.
sentences.zh: “你们不参加啊。”

sentences.en: OK, thank you.
sentences.zh: “好的，谢谢。”

sentences.en: So that he can have these stories about the fair is lying about who's going to be at the fair.
sentences.zh: 这样他就能写出关于世博会在参展方问题上撒谎的报道了。

sentences.en: They advertised all these these exhibitors who are actually not going to have something there.
sentences.zh: 他们宣传了所有这些参展商，但实际上他们根本不会在那里展出任何东西。

sentences.en: And Moses, he has this this bad press conference where he gets angry at the reporters.
sentences.zh: 而摩西，他召开了一场糟糕的新闻发布会，对记者大发雷霆。

sentences.en: He has a luncheon with the editors of The Times that he hosts that is meant to clear the air.
sentences.zh: 他举办了一场午宴招待《泰晤士报》的编辑们，本意是想缓和关系。

sentences.en: And then he walks out of it.
sentences.zh: 结果他中途离场了。

sentences.en: He walks out of the dinner that he is hosting.
sentences.zh: 他竟然从自己举办的晚宴上中途离场。

sentences.en: And just whatever is going on that could be a failing of the fair, the press pounces on, criticizes.
sentences.zh: 无论世博会出了什么差错，媒体都会抓住不放，大加批判。

sentences.en: And the press ideally would be supporting this fair.
sentences.zh: 按理说，媒体本该支持这次世博会。

sentences.en: They have an interest in it.
sentences.zh: 他们从中是有利益关联的。

sentences.en: They want New York City to look good.
sentences.zh: 他们希望纽约市看起来光鲜亮丽。

sentences.en: If there's advertising dollars to be spent on this fair, it'll be spent at newspapers.
sentences.zh: 如果世博会有广告预算，那钱就会流向报社。

sentences.en: But they're just so mad, mad at Moses.
sentences.zh: 但他们实在太生气了，对摩西非常愤怒。

sentences.en: They're just just barking mad at Moses, you know, that they're ready to take him down.
sentences.zh: 他们简直对摩西恨之入骨，你知道的，他们已经准备好要搞垮他了。

sentences.en: And Moses's reactions to this start turning away potential investors to the fair.
sentences.zh: 而摩西对此的反应开始让潜在的投资者对世博会望而却步。

sentences.en: And it's it's just there's a there's these places where Moses does not have to take the bait.
sentences.zh: 有些时候，摩西本不必上钩的。

sentences.en: A controversy starts.
sentences.zh: 争议一旦开始。

sentences.en: And instead of letting it play itself out or deflecting it, he just goes head on at it and escalates things over and over again.
sentences.zh: 他非但没有让事情自然平息或转移焦点，反而正面硬刚，导致事态一次又一次升级。

sentences.en: Things just keep getting worse and worse.
sentences.zh: 情况变得越来越糟。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错。

sentences.en: And then the fair actually launches.
sentences.zh: 然后世博会正式开幕了。

sentences.en: And that's when the things really start to wheels really start to come off, because it turns out that if you don't pay attention to a fair, no one really wants to go to it.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，事情真的开始失控了，因为事实证明，如果你不重视世博会，根本没人想去。

sentences.en: Yes, that's a that's a that's a big thing.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个非常严重的问题。

sentences.en: I think there's a well, that part of the issue is that also in advertising the fair, they have mostly advertised Robert Moses's involvement in the fair to a certain extent.
sentences.zh: 我认为，问题的一部分在于，他们在宣传世博会时，在很大程度上主要宣传的是罗伯特·摩西的参与。

sentences.en: Like, you know, it's going to be good.
sentences.zh: 就像是说，你知道的，这一定会很棒。

sentences.en: Robert Moses is doing it.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·摩西在操办呢。

sentences.en: And that doesn't mean quite what it once did.
sentences.zh: 但这已经不像过去那样有号召力了。

sentences.en: And but they don't have a master plan for this fair.
sentences.zh: 而且他们对这次世博会根本没有总体规划。

sentences.en: It's kind of messy and it's kind of sloppy.
sentences.zh: 整个过程显得杂乱无章，非常草率。

sentences.en: And there are fun things about it.
sentences.zh: 不过里面也有一些有趣的东西。

sentences.en: There's I like there's a nice description that that Kara has where he goes out of the flushing meadows and expanse of flat, barren, almost unadorned land.
sentences.zh: 卡拉有一段很棒的描述，他说法拉盛草原是一片平坦、荒凉、几乎没有任何装饰的土地。

sentences.en: There took shape now a square mile of forms out of the past, like the thatched replicas of African tribal huts housing treehouse restaurants, of forms out of the future,
sentences.zh: 那里现在形成了一平方英里的过去形态，比如像非洲部落茅屋的复制品，里面是树屋餐厅，还有未来的形态，

sentences.en: like the hulking massiveness of the United States pavilion and of traditional fairground adornments, such as the curving, looming dark walls of the Hall of Science,
sentences.zh: 比如美国馆那庞大的体量，以及传统的游乐场装饰，比如科学馆那弯曲、阴沉的深色墙壁，

sentences.en: the little brightly colored cable cars swinging in procession overhead.
sentences.zh: 还有头顶上缓缓经过的色彩鲜艳的小缆车。

sentences.en: And the clusters of white balloons that marked the brass rail hot dog stands scattered throughout the grounds.
sentences.zh: 以及散布在场地各处、标志着黄铜栏杆热狗摊的一簇簇白气球。

sentences.en: And he mentions this is a scene that may not have titillated the sophisticated taste of New York intelligentsia, but that would have thrilled the general public.
sentences.zh: 他提到，这一幕可能无法取悦纽约知识分子的挑剔品味，但却会让普通大众感到兴奋。

sentences.en: Like, this probably would be a fun place to take your kids.
sentences.zh: 就像是，这可能是一个带孩子去玩的好地方。

sentences.en: But all you know about it is this mean man is running it, this mean, angry old man.
sentences.zh: 但大家只知道是一个刻薄的人在经营它，一个刻薄、愤怒的老头。

sentences.en: And so, like you're saying, people don't start showing up to the fair and they need us to hit a certain attendance level.
sentences.zh: 所以，就像你说的，人们开始不去世博会了，而他们需要达到一定的入场人数。

sentences.en: They've borrowed so much money.
sentences.zh: 他们借了太多的钱。

sentences.en: They've paid so much money that the fair has to bring in 220,000 paying customers every day and every single day for two years, for two seasons.
sentences.zh: 他们投入了太多的资金，以至于世博会必须在两年、两个季度里，每天都有22万名付费游客入场。

sentences.en: And Moses is like, we'll have plenty of quarter million days.
sentences.zh: 摩西却说，我们会迎来很多单日25万游客的日子。

sentences.en: We'll have plenty of them, but that's not what happens.
sentences.zh: 我们会有的，但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Attendance on the opening day is April 22nd, 1964, 49,642 people show up.
sentences.zh: 1964年4月22日开幕当天，入场人数只有49,642人。

sentences.en: Like, that's bad.
sentences.zh: 这很糟糕。

sentences.en: That's very bad.
sentences.zh: 非常糟糕。

sentences.en: And Moses is like, the weather was bad.
sentences.zh: 摩西却说，是天气不好。

sentences.en: It'll be better when the weather clears up.
sentences.zh: 天气好转后会好起来的。

sentences.en: The next day, weather's a little better.
sentences.zh: 第二天，天气稍微好了一点。

sentences.en: Attendance is 88,130.
sentences.zh: 入场人数是88,130人。

sentences.en: He goes, wait until May when it gets warmer.
sentences.zh: 他说，等着瞧吧，五月份天气暖和了就好了。

sentences.en: No days in May when it gets as high.
sentences.zh: 五月份根本没有哪天达到过那个数字。

sentences.en: Wait till July when the school's let out.
sentences.zh: 等着瞧吧，七月份学校放假就好了。

sentences.en: July comes.
sentences.zh: 七月到了。

sentences.en: Attend the fair is 10 million less than they need to have attending it to break even by the end of that July.
sentences.zh: 到七月底，世博会的入场人数比收支平衡所需的目标少了1000万。

sentences.en: The fair is not just not making the profit he expected.
sentences.zh: 世博会不仅没能实现他预期的利润。

sentences.en: It's not even breaking even.
sentences.zh: 甚至连收支平衡都没达到。

sentences.en: But Moses, here's one of the great things about having yes men all around you.
sentences.zh: 但摩西，这就是身边全是唯唯诺诺之人的好处之一。

sentences.en: Do people tell Moses that the fair is not doing well?
sentences.zh: 有人告诉摩西世博会经营不善吗？

sentences.en: No, they don't tell him anything about it.
sentences.zh: 不，他们什么都没告诉他。

sentences.en: In fact, so he's not really fully aware of the dire straits he's in financially.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他并没有完全意识到自己正处于严重的财务困境中。

sentences.en: And so he ends up bringing Triborough's comptroller, Erwin Witt, to be the fair's comptroller so he can sort of get a handle on this.
sentences.zh: 所以他最终把三区大桥管理局的财务总监欧文·威特调来担任世博会的财务总监，想以此来掌控局面。

sentences.en: And one of the things about him is because he's so used to the endless stream of money pouring in as the comptroller of Triborough.
sentences.zh: 他这个人有一个特点，因为他作为三区大桥管理局的财务总监，习惯了源源不断的资金流入。

sentences.en: Like, I don't know if he's ever balanced the books because he doesn't ever have to.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他是否真的平衡过账目，因为他根本不需要。

sentences.en: It seems like his job is to be like, things are going great, Mr. Moses.
sentences.zh: 他的工作似乎就是说：“一切都很顺利，摩西先生。”

sentences.en: Things are going great, RM.
sentences.zh: “一切都很顺利，RM。”

sentences.en: Like, he doesn't seem to know how to do these things.
sentences.zh: 他似乎根本不知道该怎么处理这些事。

sentences.en: He makes this big mistake where the fair has all these advanced ticket sales.
sentences.zh: 他犯了一个大错，世博会有很多预售票。

sentences.en: And some of them are for the first year.
sentences.zh: 其中一些是第一年的。

sentences.en: Some of them are for the second year.
sentences.zh: 一些是第二年的。

sentences.en: But he just puts all that money and credits it to the first year of the fair, which means that for the second year of the fair, they're going to have millions and millions of,
sentences.zh: 但他把所有的钱都算作了第一年的收入，这意味着到了世博会第二年，他们会有数以百万计的、

sentences.en: accounting-wise, unpaid attendees.
sentences.zh: 从会计角度看，未付费的入场者。

sentences.en: So not only do they need a certain number of people, now they need even more people because there's this gap in this money.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不仅需要一定数量的游客，现在因为资金缺口，他们需要更多的游客。

sentences.en: Like, the intent is just not going to be high enough to cover that.
sentences.zh: 入场人数根本不可能高到足以填补这个缺口。

sentences.en: And everyone's afraid of telling Moses this.
sentences.zh: 每个人都害怕告诉摩西这一点。

sentences.en: The only one who'll do it is his longtime aide, George Spargo, who you may remember from the last episode, eating a bowl of soup while talking to reporters.
sentences.zh: 唯一敢说的人是他长期的助手乔治·斯帕戈，你可能还记得上一集里他一边喝汤一边接受记者采访的样子。

sentences.en: It's really offending them that he couldn't even stop his soup for a moment.
sentences.zh: 他甚至连喝汤的时间都不肯停下来，这真的冒犯了记者们。

sentences.en: And he's been working for Moses for 30 years.
sentences.zh: 他为摩西工作了30年。

sentences.en: And he even goes on double dates with Moses, which I think is a very funny detail.
sentences.zh: 他甚至和摩西一起进行双重约会，我觉得这是一个非常有趣的细节。

sentences.en: And Spargo tells him the truth.
sentences.zh: 斯帕戈告诉了他真相。

sentences.en: The fair is not making money.
sentences.zh: 世博会不赚钱。

sentences.en: We're losing money.
sentences.zh: 我们在亏钱。

sentences.en: And Moses fires him.
sentences.zh: 然后摩西解雇了他。

sentences.en: And Moses yells at Erwin with the comptroller for three hours with such ferocity that a few days later he has a heart attack and eventually dies from heart trouble.
sentences.zh: 摩西对财务总监欧文·威特咆哮了三个小时，凶狠程度之高，以至于几天后他就心脏病发作，最终因心脏问题去世了。

sentences.en: So Moses has run this fair so poorly that at least one person has died as a consequence of, I don't know, the management of it.
sentences.zh: 所以摩西把这次世博会搞得一团糟，以至于至少有一个人因为这个管理问题而丧命。

sentences.en: And Moses is trying – he goes, okay, we've got to try to cut spending.
sentences.zh: 摩西试图——他说，好吧，我们得设法削减开支。

sentences.en: We've got to save money.
sentences.zh: 我们得省钱。

sentences.en: But he signed these contracts.
sentences.zh: 但他签下的那些合同。

sentences.en: They're just way too generous.
sentences.zh: 实在太慷慨了。

sentences.en: They can't be renegotiated.
sentences.zh: 根本无法重新谈判。

sentences.en: The fair keeps owing money.
sentences.zh: 世博会一直在欠债。

sentences.en: Moses tries to inflate the attendance and sales figures to the public to make it seem better.
sentences.zh: 摩西试图向公众夸大入场人数和销售数据，让情况看起来好一些。

sentences.en: And his employees are just too scared to tell him really what the situation is.
sentences.zh: 而他的员工太害怕了，不敢告诉他真实情况。

sentences.en: But this is real money.
sentences.zh: 但这可是真金白银。

sentences.en: It's not play money.
sentences.zh: 不是闹着玩的。

sentences.en: So there has to be a reckoning.
sentences.zh: 所以必须有个了断。

sentences.en: And that reckoning comes in December of that year.
sentences.zh: 那个了断发生在那一年的12月。

sentences.en: So there's a finance committee that has like bank presidents on it for the fair.
sentences.zh: 当时有一个财务委员会，里面有银行行长之类的成员。

sentences.en: And they're like, things don't seem like they're going that well with the fair.
sentences.zh: 他们说，世博会的情况看起来不太妙。

sentences.en: We don't really trust the books.
sentences.zh: 我们不太相信这些账目。

sentences.en: They bring in an outside auditor who is a Chase Bank Rockefeller guy.
sentences.zh: 他们请来了一位外部审计师，是来自大通银行洛克菲勒那边的人。

sentences.en: He's a guy from that world.
sentences.zh: 他是那个圈子里的人。

sentences.en: And he discovers that rather than the surplus of $12 million that Moses said they had, the fair has a deficit of $14 million.
sentences.zh: 他发现，世博会不仅没有摩西所说的1200万美元盈余，反而有1400万美元的赤字。

sentences.en: So that's a $26 million difference in 1964.
sentences.zh: 在1964年，这可是2600万美元的差距。

sentences.en: And Moses is like, hey, you know what?
sentences.zh: 摩西却说，嘿，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Let me charm you.
sentences.zh: 让我来搞定你。

sentences.en: I'll pour on the old RM charm.
sentences.zh: 我要施展一下我那老派的RM魅力。

sentences.en: That doesn't work.
sentences.zh: 那招没用。

sentences.en: So then he tries to intimidate him.
sentences.zh: 于是他试图恐吓对方。

sentences.en: Hey, if you want this job, you've got to stick around.
sentences.zh: “嘿，如果你想保住这份工作，你就得听话。”

sentences.en: And one of his intimidation things that I think is great is he says, you can't show up at the fair employee Christmas party.
sentences.zh: 他恐吓人的手段之一我觉得很绝，他说，你不准参加世博会员工的圣诞派对。

sentences.en: Or maybe it's the Triborough employee Christmas party.
sentences.zh: 或者可能是三区大桥管理局的员工圣诞派对。

sentences.en: But it's such a petty thing.
sentences.zh: 但这真是太小家子气了。

sentences.en: And this auditor, he says, no, this fair is insolvent.
sentences.zh: 而这位审计师说，不，这家世博会已经资不抵债了。

sentences.en: And he stands by his report.
sentences.zh: 他坚持自己的报告。

sentences.en: He sends it to one of the bankers on the finance committee.
sentences.zh: 他把报告发给了财务委员会的一位银行家。

sentences.en: And the bankers are aghast at how sloppy the bookkeeping is.
sentences.zh: 银行家们对账目的混乱感到震惊。

sentences.en: They're aghast at Moses' attitude.
sentences.zh: 他们对摩西的态度感到震惊。

sentences.en: And they leave the committee.
sentences.zh: 他们退出了委员会。

sentences.en: And now they're publicly commenting on the fair's lack of money.
sentences.zh: 现在他们公开评论世博会资金匮乏的问题。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of reporters who have been just looking to get back at the guy who's been calling them jackals and vultures.
sentences.zh: 有很多记者一直想找机会报复那个称他们为“豺狼和秃鹫”的家伙。

sentences.en: And they pounce on it saying the fair is in money trouble.
sentences.zh: 他们抓住机会大肆报道世博会陷入了财务危机。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Moses goes into action.
sentences.zh: 摩西开始行动了。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So he begins to start, like, you know, trying to make the 1965 season better, you know, by getting a Gutenberg Bible, which would be – I would like to see that.
sentences.zh: 他开始着手，你知道的，试图让1965年的展期更好，比如弄来一本古腾堡圣经，那可是——我很想看看那个。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The Pope's coronation tiara.
sentences.zh: 还有教皇的加冕三重冕。

sentences.en: Carol says he gets a lot of good stuff for the fair.
sentences.zh: 卡拉说他为世博会弄到了很多好东西。

sentences.en: But he also – my favorite thing is he loosens the restrictions they had on adult material at the fair.
sentences.zh: 但他还——我最喜欢的一点是，他放宽了世博会对成人内容的限制。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it means that – so it says, no longer were he and Constable screening out tawdry shows and auditioning the ones allowed in
sentences.zh: 这意味着——所以上面写着，他和警长不再筛选那些低俗的表演，也不再对获准入场的节目进行审核了。

sentences.en: to make certain that female dancers did not display belly buttons or cleavage.
sentences.zh: 以确保女舞者不会露出肚脐或乳沟。

sentences.en: In 1965, there would be nine discotheques featuring go-go dancers, and their bras were creeping further down nightly.
sentences.zh: 1965年，有九家迪斯科舞厅雇用了戈戈舞女，她们的胸罩每晚都在不断下移。

sentences.en: In 1964, Moses had insisted that bras be put on Les Poupées de Paris and that sexy posters be taken off the front doors of that show.
sentences.zh: 1964年，摩西曾坚持要求《巴黎玩偶》表演中的木偶穿上胸罩，并撤掉该演出大门上性感的宣传海报。

sentences.en: In 1965, the girl taking tickets outside was spilling out of her bikini, quote,
sentences.zh: 1965年，在外面检票的女孩，用引用的话说，她的比基尼已经快包不住了，

sentences.en: to make the show's point perfectly clear, its promoter explained.
sentences.zh: 演出发起人解释说，这是为了让演出的主题更加鲜明。

sentences.en: And this is – Les Poupées de Paris is a kind of risque puppet show.
sentences.zh: 这就是——《巴黎玩偶》是一种带点儿色情的木偶戏。

sentences.en: So that's what got the Croft brothers, Sid and Marty Croft.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是克罗夫特兄弟，西德和马蒂·克罗夫特，成名的方式。

sentences.en: That's what made them into real big names.
sentences.zh: 这让他们真正成为了大人物。

sentences.en: And they would go on to make all the Saturday morning cartoons that kids in the 70s grew up with.
sentences.zh: 他们后来制作了所有70年代孩子们看着长大的周六早间动画片。

sentences.en: But he's like – before, he was like, this is a class fair.
sentences.zh: 但他之前就像是说，这是一个高档博览会。

sentences.en: It's going to be very classy.
sentences.zh: 它会非常有档次。

sentences.en: And then by 65, he's like, do the puppets have to wear bras?
sentences.zh: 然后到了65年，他却说，木偶非得穿胸罩吗？

sentences.en: Like, is it possible that everyone can be in bikinis?
sentences.zh: 就像是，大家都能穿比基尼难道不行吗？

sentences.en: And what's getting clear here is that, you know, people are starting to get nervous about this.
sentences.zh: 显而易见的是，你知道，人们开始对此感到不安了。

sentences.en: The lack of attendance is not just a story of failure, you know, to view it in the papers.
sentences.zh: 入场人数不足不仅仅是一个失败的故事，你知道，从报纸上的报道来看。

sentences.en: Like, people have invested in this.
sentences.zh: 就像是，人们已经在这上面投入了资金。

sentences.en: And they're starting to cotton on to the idea that they are not going to get their money back.
sentences.zh: 他们开始意识到，他们可能拿不回自己的钱了。

sentences.en: And that's when things really, you know, like the wheels really come off because, you know, when the money people don't want Moses around, you know, he has to begin hiding more.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，事情真的，你知道，就像彻底失控了，因为，你知道，当金主们不再想见到摩西时，你知道，他必须开始更多地躲藏起来。

sentences.en: He has to sort of figure out ways to sort of convince them that he's the right person for the job.
sentences.zh: 他必须想办法说服他们，他就是这份工作的合适人选。

sentences.en: And at this point, they kind of want his head.
sentences.zh: 而此时，他们恨不得要他的命。

sentences.en: He is facing accountability in a way that he has never,
sentences.zh: 他正面临着一种前所未有的问责，

sentences.en: ever really faced before in one of these organizations because his power is built on those two pillars mainly of – or three pillars, let's say – of popularity with the public,
sentences.zh: 在这些组织中他从未真正面对过，因为他的权力主要建立在那两大支柱上——或者说三大支柱吧——即公众的欢迎度、

sentences.en: money that he can spread around, and the fact that he can write the laws.
sentences.zh: 他可以随意支配的资金，以及他能够制定法律的事实。

sentences.en: So he kind of knows the ins and outs and details of laws in the way that nobody else does.
sentences.zh: 所以他很了解法律的内幕和细节，这是其他人所不具备的。

sentences.en: But in this case, he's not very popular anymore.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，他已经不再那么受欢迎了。

sentences.en: He doesn't have that money to spread around.
sentences.zh: 他没有那些钱可以随意支配了。

sentences.en: And there's no – it's a lawless land, World's Fair.
sentences.zh: 而且这里没有——世博会简直是个无法无天的地方。

sentences.en: You know, there's no like hidden legislation he can use to get his way.
sentences.zh: 你知道，没有那种他可以利用的隐形立法来达到目的。

sentences.en: And it means that by a certain point, people are getting the feeling that he is hiding money and maybe even stealing money because they find out about how big his salary is.
sentences.zh: 这意味着到了一定程度，人们开始觉得他在藏钱，甚至可能在偷钱，因为他们发现了他的薪水有多高。

sentences.en: He's making like $100,000 a year doing this, I think more than that.
sentences.zh: 我想他做这个一年能赚10万美元，甚至更多。

sentences.en: And that was part of the attraction was he needs money to support his family, and this will pay him money.
sentences.zh: 而这也是吸引力的一部分，他需要钱来养家糊口，而这能给他报酬。

sentences.en: But there's this feeling that the fair is losing money, the city is losing money, the investors are losing money, and Moses is not.
sentences.zh: 但人们有一种感觉，博览会在亏钱，城市在亏钱，投资者在亏钱，而摩西却没有。

sentences.en: And for the first time, people start to think of him as greedy.
sentences.zh: 这是人们第一次开始认为他贪婪。

sentences.en: They start to think that, oh, Moses is not the guy who doesn't care about money.
sentences.zh: 他们开始想，哦，摩西并不是那个不在乎钱的人。

sentences.en: This is the guy who does want money, something that nobody had ever thought about him before.
sentences.zh: 这家伙其实很想要钱，这是以前从未有人想过他的地方。

sentences.en: And that's really bad for him.
sentences.zh: 这对他的形象非常不利。

sentences.en: And at this point, people are suggesting that maybe he should resign.
sentences.zh: 此时，人们开始建议他或许应该辞职。

sentences.en: The thing that was always such a terrifying prospect when he brought it up is now something that they're suggesting.
sentences.zh: 以前他提起辞职时，那总是一个令人恐惧的前景，而现在这成了人们主动提出的建议。

sentences.en: Kara says, for years he had been threatening to resign from one post or another, confident that no one would take him up on the threat.
sentences.zh: 卡罗说，多年来他一直威胁要辞去这个或那个职位，确信没人会真的让他辞职。

sentences.en: Now people were asking him to resign.
sentences.zh: 现在人们却在要求他辞职。

sentences.en: And remember, by this point, it's after he has resigned from the state posts and went to no reaction whatsoever from most of the public.
sentences.zh: 记住，到这个时候，那是在他辞去州政府职务之后，而大多数公众对此毫无反应。

sentences.en: So he's gone all the way around now to the guy who the very thought of him resigning makes people shiver to people saying, like, he should leave.
sentences.zh: 所以他已经彻底变了，从那个让人一想到他辞职就战栗的人，变成了人们说他应该离开的人。

sentences.en: Like, we shouldn't have him doing this anymore.
sentences.zh: 就像是，我们不该再让他干这个了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And it's clear, like, he doesn't really want to be doing it either.
sentences.zh: 很明显，他自己其实也不想再干了。

sentences.en: But he just can't resign just for the sake of, I think, his ego at this point.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，此时此刻，仅仅为了他的自尊心，他无法辞职。

sentences.en: And he also probably needs to hold on to what little he can so that he is not completely blamed for everything.
sentences.zh: 而且他可能还需要紧紧抓住他所能抓住的一点权力，这样他就不会被完全归咎于所有事情。

sentences.en: You know, like, there's a chance because the IRS enters the scene to audit the fair.
sentences.zh: 你知道，因为国税局介入调查博览会，这还是有可能的。

sentences.en: The audit never actually goes through.
sentences.zh: 审计实际上从未真正完成。

sentences.en: But I think there's a real worry that they will find some illegal stuff in there if he's not in control of things, be able to sort of, like, guide this investigation.
sentences.zh: 但我认为人们真的很担心，如果他不掌控局面，无法引导这次调查，他们会在里面发现一些非法勾当。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And he doesn't want to leave in disgrace.
sentences.zh: 而且他不想在耻辱中离开。

sentences.en: He always wants to seem like he's leaving in triumph.
sentences.zh: 他总是希望看起来像是凯旋而归。

sentences.en: So he does look for other jobs.
sentences.zh: 所以他确实在寻找其他工作。

sentences.en: There's one point where he's like, hey, I hear you might want to build a canal in Colombia because the Panama Canal is going to be handed back to Panama.
sentences.zh: 有一次他说，嘿，我听说你们可能想在哥伦比亚建一条运河，因为巴拿马运河要归还给巴拿马了。

sentences.en: Like, I could do that.
sentences.zh: 就像是，我能干那个。

sentences.en: I could do that.
sentences.zh: 我能干那个。

sentences.en: And when people vote to try to remove him on the board, he has his blackmail files that he can use to sway people into supporting him.
sentences.zh: 当人们投票试图将他从董事会中除名时，他有他的勒索档案，可以用来左右人们支持他。

sentences.en: Like, he still has power over this turf,
sentences.zh: 就像是，他仍然对这块地盘有控制权，

sentences.en: and he doesn't want to let go of it unless either it looks like he's doing it voluntarily just because he wants to or unless it's going to lead him to something more powerful.
sentences.zh: 除非看起来像是他自愿放弃，或者除非这能带他走向更有权势的职位，否则他不想放手。

sentences.en: And he even tries to find ways to use the Tribro money to prop up the fair at a certain point.
sentences.zh: 他甚至在某个阶段试图寻找方法利用三区大桥管理局的钱来支撑博览会。

sentences.en: But there's no way to get out of it.
sentences.zh: 但已经无法挽回了。

sentences.en: The fair is a buSt.
sentences.zh: 博览会彻底失败了。

sentences.en: He can't pay back the city the money that it borrowed.
sentences.zh: 他无法偿还城市借出的钱。

sentences.en: Robert Moses Park is just not going to happen.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·摩西公园注定是建不成了。

sentences.en: He's going to – this is the worst thing he could be, according to Robert Caro, is he's just like Grover Whelan, the president of the 39 World's Fair.
sentences.zh: 他将要——用罗伯特·卡罗的话说，这是他能成为的最糟糕的事情，他就像39年世博会主席格罗弗·惠伦一样。

sentences.en: And they can't even pay to tear down the buildings when the fair is done.
sentences.zh: 博览会结束后，他们甚至没钱拆除建筑。

sentences.en: When they're done, which would leave him his park to make, which he can't.
sentences.zh: 当他们结束时，本该留下公园让他建造，但他做不到。

sentences.en: I mean, he can't even – he can't clear the land.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他甚至连地都清理不了。

sentences.en: He can't – doesn't have the money to build it up.
sentences.zh: 他没有钱去建设它。

sentences.en: He didn't create any of that surplus.
sentences.zh: 他没能创造出任何盈余。

sentences.en: There are like a couple of like – as the fair is winding down, there are a couple of those, you know, 220 plus days.
sentences.zh: 在博览会接近尾声时，有那么几天，你知道，那220多天里的几天。

sentences.en: They start having 500,000 persons.
sentences.zh: 入场人数开始达到50万人。

sentences.en: It's like as the fair is ending, the press is like, oh, by the way, the fair is ending.
sentences.zh: 就像是博览会快结束时，媒体才说，哦，顺便提一下，博览会要结束了。

sentences.en: And people start going like, oh, I wanted to see that.
sentences.zh: 人们才开始说，哦，我想去看看。

sentences.en: And so by the end of the fair, they actually have money on hand.
sentences.zh: 所以到博览会结束时，他们手头确实有钱了。

sentences.en: They have some money and they get those big attendance days and it shows you that this would have been possible.
sentences.zh: 他们有了一些钱，也迎来了那些入场高峰日，这说明这本来是有可能的。

sentences.en: Like a different fair potentially, a different way of relating to the press and selling it might have brought in – I still don't think it would have made any money.
sentences.zh: 如果是一个不同的博览会，或者以不同的方式与媒体沟通和营销，可能会带来——虽然我仍然认为它不会赚钱。

sentences.en: But it would have been quite as big a disaster.
sentences.zh: 但也不会像现在这么惨烈。

sentences.en: And he has this money on hand and he goes, you know what?
sentences.zh: 他手头有了这些钱，他说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I'm not going to pay back any of the investors with it.
sentences.zh: 我才不会用这些钱去偿还任何投资者。

sentences.en: I'm going to spend that money on my new park.
sentences.zh: 我要把这些钱花在我的新公园上。

sentences.en: And the courts are like, you have to at least give some of that money to the investors.
sentences.zh: 法院说，你至少得把其中的一部分钱还给投资者。

sentences.en: You can't – it can't all just go to this park dream that you have.
sentences.zh: 你不能——不能全花在你那个公园梦上。

sentences.en: And he ends up giving them back – it's like, you know, 30 cents on the dollar or something, roughly the same return on investment the 39 fair had given back in 1939.
sentences.zh: 最后他退还给他们——大概是每美元30美分左右，这和39年世博会的回报率差不多。

sentences.en: And the rest goes to just cleaning up the site and making it usable for the public.
sentences.zh: 剩下的钱就用于清理场地，使其对公众可用。

sentences.en: And some of those structures, like I said, are still there.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，其中一些建筑至今仍在那里。

sentences.en: And Moses makes a big deal about it as if this was a huge victory.
sentences.zh: 摩西大肆宣扬，仿佛这是一场巨大的胜利。

sentences.en: How, look, we have this beautiful park.
sentences.zh: 看，我们有这么漂亮的公园。

sentences.en: This used to be an ash dump.
sentences.zh: 这曾经是个垃圾堆。

sentences.en: Look, we did it.
sentences.zh: 看，我们做到了。

sentences.en: But, you know, but it is – it's far from this lavish dream that he had of this park that would make Queens the showpiece of the world.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，这远非他梦想中那个能让皇后区成为世界展示中心的奢华公园。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And Caro, he totals up the public money spent by Robert Moses in preparing the site for the 39 and the 64 fairs.
sentences.zh: 卡罗统计了罗伯特·摩西为准备39年和64年博览会场地所花费的公共资金。

sentences.en: And it comes up to about $140 million.
sentences.zh: 总额大约是1.4亿美元。

sentences.en: And that's so much money to consider.
sentences.zh: 这笔钱数额巨大，令人咋舌。

sentences.en: Remember that whole West Side improvement that was like $90 million?
sentences.zh: 还记得那个耗资9000万美元的西区改造项目吗？

sentences.en: And it was – and it did everything it was supposed to do and it – like people use it.
sentences.zh: 它完成了所有预期的目标，而且人们确实在使用它。

sentences.en: This is – dreams are expensive, you know.
sentences.zh: 这就是——梦想是很昂贵的，你知道。

sentences.en: And there's no notion that this spot in Flushing Meadows should be named after him.
sentences.zh: 而且现在没人觉得法拉盛草原的这个地方应该以他的名字命名。

sentences.en: This is the end of him being revered in this way.
sentences.zh: 这是他受人尊崇地位的终结。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And Caro, he says, Moses ran this fair at the same way he kind of ran his other projects, but this time he couldn't hide his methods.
sentences.zh: 卡罗说，摩西经营这个博览会的方式和他经营其他项目一样，但这一次他无法掩盖自己的手段。

sentences.en: He couldn't – he had to do it out in the open because this was a kind of a corporation with investors as opposed to a semi-private,
sentences.zh: 他不得不公开进行，因为这是一种有投资者的公司，而不是半私营、

sentences.en: semi-public authority or an official institution.
sentences.zh: 半公营的机构或官方组织。

sentences.en: And because of that salary he had, he's just not seen anymore as the guy who doesn't care about money.
sentences.zh: 正因为他拿的那份薪水，他不再被视为那个不在乎钱的人。

sentences.en: And Caro says, he was in public disrepute so great that his name had become a symbol for things the public hated.
sentences.zh: 卡罗说，他名誉扫地，以至于他的名字成了公众所憎恨事物的代名词。

sentences.en: Like he is no longer Parks.
sentences.zh: 他不再是公园的化身。

sentences.en: He is now greed and being mean to people.
sentences.zh: 他现在代表的是贪婪和刻薄。

sentences.en: And Caro says, if he were an elected official, he'd be voted out of office.
sentences.zh: 卡罗说，如果他是民选官员，他早就被选下台了。

sentences.en: If he was a political appointee, he would be fired by that elected official.
sentences.zh: 如果他是政治任命的官员，他早就被那位民选官员解雇了。

sentences.en: But he's still the head of Tribro.
sentences.zh: 但他仍然是三区大桥管理局的负责人。

sentences.en: He's still the head of a public authority, and nobody can remove him at all.
sentences.zh: 他仍然是公共机构的负责人，根本没人能撤掉他。

sentences.en: It's just – it can't be done.
sentences.zh: 就是这样——根本做不到。

sentences.en: And the chapter ends on a – every now and then, Robert Caro will be like, oh, yeah, and here's something about Robert Moses' family.
sentences.zh: 这一章结束时——罗伯特·卡罗时不时会说，哦，对了，这里还有些关于罗伯特·摩西家庭的事情。

sentences.en: Just to keep you up to that.
sentences.zh: 只是为了让你了解情况。

sentences.en: And he basically just ends the chapter with a semi-unrelated but chronological kind of description of what's going on with Mary Moses, Robert Moses' wife, who, as you know,
sentences.zh: 他基本上是以一种半相关但按时间顺序的描述结束了这一章，讲述了罗伯特·摩西的妻子玛丽·摩西的情况，如你所知，

sentences.en: in earlier chapters, she was so necessary to his life.
sentences.zh: 在前面的章节里，她对他的人生是多么重要。

sentences.en: She was the one who kept the day-to-day of his life going so that he could do these big things.
sentences.zh: 是她维持了他日常生活的运转，他才能去成就那些大事。

sentences.en: And she has deteriorated so much.
sentences.zh: 而她的身体状况已经恶化得非常严重。

sentences.en: And by her early 60s, she's having recurring hospitalizations, and she's confined to a wheelchair.
sentences.zh: 到了60岁出头，她频繁住院，只能坐轮椅。

sentences.en: And his daughter, Jane, takes up those responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 他的女儿简承担了那些责任。

sentences.en: And Robert Moses seems to start a relationship with someone who people around him call Mary, too, whose name is Mary Grady, or maybe it's Mary II,
sentences.zh: 而罗伯特·摩西似乎开始与一个身边人也叫玛丽的人建立关系，她的名字叫玛丽·格雷迪，或者可能是玛丽二世，

sentences.en: a secretary who's 28 years younger than Robert Moses.
sentences.zh: 一个比罗伯特·摩西年轻28岁的秘书。

sentences.en: And she starts going with him to parties and vacations.
sentences.zh: 她开始陪他参加聚会和度假。

sentences.en: And Moses is always kind of courteous, always financially supports his first wife, but they just do not share a life anymore.
sentences.zh: 摩西总是很客气，在经济上一直支持他的第一任妻子，但他们已经不再共享生活了。

sentences.en: And their friends believe that Mary's decline began when Moses began facing real public criticism, that she would get so enraged by the criticism,
sentences.zh: 他们的朋友认为，玛丽的衰落始于摩西开始面临真正的公众批评时，她会被这些批评激怒，

sentences.en: and it would kind of burn her out.
sentences.zh: 这会让她心力交瘁。

sentences.en: And she dies in 1966, the year after the fair is over.
sentences.zh: 她在1966年去世，也就是博览会结束后的第二年。

sentences.en: And less than a month later, Moses, he's 77 years old, and he marries Mary II, Mary Grady, who is 49 years old.
sentences.zh: 不到一个月后，77岁的摩西娶了49岁的玛丽二世，即玛丽·格雷迪。

sentences.en: So, this chapter is such a huge closing of an era for Robert Moses in that his power is so greatly diminished, his reputation is so greatly diminished,
sentences.zh: 所以，这一章对罗伯特·摩西来说是一个时代的巨大终结，他的权力大大减弱，声誉也大大受损，

sentences.en: and even the woman who made so much of that power possible by allowing his life to proceed that way and by taking care of him is no longer a part of that life.
sentences.zh: 甚至那个通过让他的生活按那种方式进行并照顾他，从而使他拥有那么多权力的女人，也不再是他生活的一部分了。

sentences.en: She's passed on.
sentences.zh: 她已经离世了。

sentences.en: And when the book was released and Robert Moses reacted to it by calling Robert Caro a venomous viper, among other things.
sentences.zh: 当这本书出版时，罗伯特·摩西的反应是称罗伯特·卡罗为毒蛇，以及其他一些称呼。

sentences.en: Which is a little redundant.
sentences.zh: 这有点多余了。

sentences.en: I would say so.
sentences.zh: 我也这么认为。

sentences.en: But it does sound like him, you know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 但这听起来确实很像他，你明白我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That's his style of writing.
sentences.zh: 这就是他的写作风格。

sentences.en: But the first and most vociferous reaction and complaint that he has in this sort of 20-page letter that he releases publicly is about this.
sentences.zh: 但他在这份公开的20页信件中，最先提出且最激烈的抱怨就是关于这一点。

sentences.en: Like he takes extreme offense to the notion that he was carrying on a relationship with Mary Grady while Mary I was still alive.
sentences.zh: 他对于自己在玛丽一世还在世时就与玛丽·格雷迪保持关系的说法感到极度冒犯。

sentences.en: So, this is one thing that he greatly disputes.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是他极力反驳的一点。

sentences.en: He took great offense to this.
sentences.zh: 他对此感到非常愤怒。

sentences.en: It really is the thing that he leads with and it sort of sticks with through most of the piece.
sentences.zh: 这确实是他信中的开篇重点，并且在整篇文章的大部分内容中都纠结于此。

sentences.en: Like the little bits that he complains about like, oh, this car wasn't worth that much money and that boat wasn't real.
sentences.zh: 就像他抱怨的一些小细节，比如，哦，这辆车不值那么多钱，那艘船不是真的。

sentences.en: That was like a bathtub.
sentences.zh: 那就像个浴缸。

sentences.en: It wasn't really an expensive boat or whatever he says.
sentences.zh: 那根本不是什么昂贵的船，诸如此类。

sentences.en: This is the one where you can feel like there's a real, I don't know, like just, you know, he could be really mad because Robert Caro is mischaracterizing this.
sentences.zh: 这是唯一能让你感觉到他真的——我不知道，就是，你知道，他可能真的很生气，因为罗伯特·卡罗歪曲了事实。

sentences.en: He could be really mad because he's on to something and it's very sensitive.
sentences.zh: 他可能真的很生气，因为卡罗说中了要害，而这非常敏感。

sentences.en: I don't know, but this was, of those 1,200 pages, this seemed to be the thing that Robert Moses objected to the moSt.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，但在那1200页的内容中，这似乎是罗伯特·摩西最反对的事情。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And yeah, there's no real way of knowing exactly whether it's because it's not true or because this is the thing that is most likely to hurt his family.
sentences.zh: 而且，说实话，我们真的无法确定这究竟是因为事实并非如此，还是因为这正是最容易伤害他家人的事情。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, and the other stuff won't.
sentences.zh: 你知道，其他那些事倒不会。

sentences.en: But it's hard when Moses, so much of Moses's attacks and things like that are based on misrepresentation.
sentences.zh: 但困难在于，摩西（Moses）的许多攻击和类似行为都是基于歪曲事实。

sentences.en: It's hard to know what the true truth is.
sentences.zh: 很难分辨什么是真正的真相。

sentences.en: And it's not that hard to believe that a powerful guy would be unfaithful to his wife.
sentences.zh: 而且，相信一个有权势的人会对妻子不忠，这并不难。

sentences.en: You know, it's not a, it's not, it would not be an out of the ordinary situation for a big powerful person.
sentences.zh: 你知道，对于一个位高权重的人来说，这种情况并不罕见。

sentences.en: But, but you're right, there is something about this that particularly offends him and insults him and that he has to push back on.
sentences.zh: 但你说得对，这件事确实有些地方特别冒犯他、侮辱他，让他不得不进行反击。

sentences.en: Because you could take that month, that month between her death and his new marriage two ways.
sentences.zh: 因为你可以从两个角度来看待她去世和他再婚之间的那个月。

sentences.en: One is that's extremely insensitive and she just died and he should have more time.
sentences.zh: 一种看法是这极其冷漠，她刚去世，他本该多留些时间。

sentences.en: The other is he's 77 years old.
sentences.zh: 另一种看法是，他已经77岁了。

sentences.en: Yeah, come on.
sentences.zh: 得了吧，别这样。

sentences.en: He doesn't know how much time he has lived.
sentences.zh: 他不知道自己还能活多久。

sentences.en: You know, and if they weren't having a relationship for something 10 plus years at this point, you know, like that, you know, like you just got to live life.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果他们当时已经有十多年没有那种关系了，你知道，就像那样，你总得过自己的生活。

sentences.en: So there's all kinds of ways to take this.
sentences.zh: 所以看待这件事的角度有很多种。

sentences.en: But this was, he took real exception to the characterization that Robert Carroll wrote in this section.
sentences.zh: 但他确实对罗伯特·卡罗（Robert Caro）在这一章节中的描述感到非常不满。

sentences.en: I, for sure.
sentences.zh: 我肯定也是。

sentences.en: Maybe it shows, and maybe I'm reaching too far for a unified theory of Roman and Moses reactions.
sentences.zh: 也许这表明了——也许我对罗曼（Roman）和摩西反应的统一理论解读得太深了。

sentences.en: But I think it shows what a different place we are in in terms of public mores now that the public activities that Moses is taking and how he pushes people around,
sentences.zh: 但我认为这反映了我们现在的公共道德处于一个多么不同的境地，摩西所采取的那些公共行动以及他如何摆布他人，

sentences.en: we take such horrific offense at.
sentences.zh: 我们对此感到如此强烈的冒犯。

sentences.en: Whereas his personal relationships feel like they are not, not a thing that is as important to go into or talk about.
sentences.zh: 而他的个人关系似乎并不那么重要，不值得去深究或谈论。

sentences.en: Whereas at the time, I think it would have been very different.
sentences.zh: 而在当时，我认为情况会大不相同。

sentences.en: It would have been, well, you got to break a few eggs to make some omelets.
sentences.zh: 那时的逻辑会是：想要做成大事，难免要做出些牺牲。

sentences.en: Whereas the idea that he was, that he was not faithful to his wife would have been very damaging, most likely.
sentences.zh: 而他对他妻子不忠的想法，很可能会造成极大的损害。

sentences.en: And so I wonder if it's a, if it's a show of like, he's a, he's a man from, remember, he's, Robert Moses was born over a hundred years ago.
sentences.zh: 所以我怀疑这是否表现出……记住，他是一个来自那个时代的人，罗伯特·摩西出生于一百多年前。

sentences.en: Like he's a man from a different time, a time when driving was just a pleasant leisure activity.
sentences.zh: 他是一个来自不同时代的人，那时的驾驶仅仅是一种愉快的休闲活动。

sentences.en: You took on a Sunday down a tree lined boulevard, you know.
sentences.zh: 你可以在周日沿着林荫大道兜风，你知道的。

sentences.en: So the things that struck him as, as hurtful were different than probably what we would find now in the same way.
sentences.zh: 所以，那些让他感到受伤的事情，与我们现在所认为的可能不同，道理是一样的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But lest you think that he's really at the end of his rope, the next chapter will show you that there's a little, little fight left in this old dog.
sentences.zh: 但别以为他真的已经走投无路了，下一章会向你展示，这只老狗还有点斗志。

sentences.en: That's chapter 48, Old Lion, Young Mayor.
sentences.zh: 那是第48章，《老狮子与年轻市长》。

sentences.en: We'll talk about that one after this.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后再谈那一章。

sentences.en: So the next chapter is chapter 48, Old Lion, Young Mayor.
sentences.zh: 所以下一章是第48章，《老狮子与年轻市长》。

sentences.en: Who is the young mayor that we're talking about here?
sentences.zh: 我们这里说的年轻市长是谁？

sentences.en: The young mayor here is John Lindsay.
sentences.zh: 这里的年轻市长是约翰·林赛（John Lindsay）。

sentences.en: He was the mayor after Wagner.
sentences.zh: 他是瓦格纳（Wagner）之后的市长。

sentences.en: And I, the thing I just want to highlight here is how hard Caro disrespects John Lindsay throughout this chapter and the remainder of the book.
sentences.zh: 我想强调的一点是，卡罗在这一章以及书的剩余部分中，对约翰·林赛是多么的不尊重。

sentences.en: It's very funny to me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这非常有趣。
