sentences.en: John Lindsay for, you know, he's not well remembered for, to, for most people now, but at the time he was the young, handsome, liberal Republican mayor.
sentences.zh: 约翰·林赛，你知道，对大多数人来说，他现在已经不太被人记住了，但在当时，他是一位年轻、英俊、自由派的共和党市长。

sentences.en: He's very handsome.
sentences.zh: 他非常英俊。

sentences.en: Very handsome.
sentences.zh: 非常英俊。

sentences.en: I mean, he was an actor before he was, before he was a mayor who went into politics.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他在成为市长进入政界之前曾是一名演员。

sentences.en: They'll often say stuff like the striking countenance of Robert Moses and you go, I don't know, we're kind of grading on a curve here.
sentences.zh: 他们经常会说些诸如“罗伯特·摩西那引人注目的容貌”之类的话，你会想，我不知道，我们这是在降低标准吗？

sentences.en: But you look at John Lindsay, John Lindsay looks like, is, is as handsome as a modern politician, like a real square jaw, you know, like, yeah.
sentences.zh: 但你看看约翰·林赛，约翰·林赛看起来就像现代政客一样英俊，有着真正的方下巴，你知道，没错。

sentences.en: He's got a real Robert Redford type look too, you know, and when, and he came into New York City saying, this is now,
sentences.zh: 他看起来确实有点像罗伯特·雷德福（Robert Redford），你知道，当他来到纽约市时，他说，现在是时候了，

sentences.en: we're going to make this a modern city and we're going to make it, they called it fun city.
sentences.zh: 我们要把它变成一个现代化的城市，我们要把它变成——他们称之为“快乐之城”。

sentences.en: This is going to be a city that people enjoy being in and it's hard to read parts of this chapter now and not feel some kind of modern parallels of a relatively like a liberal reformer type coming in and being like,
sentences.zh: 这将是一个人们乐于居住的城市。现在读这一章的部分内容，很难不感受到某种现代的相似之处，一个相对自由派的改革者进来，心想：

sentences.en: well, I know I'm right and they're wrong.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我知道我是对的，他们是错的。

sentences.en: So obviously I will win and then being crushed repeatedly by the old dinosaurs that still have power and know how the system works.
sentences.zh: 所以显然我会赢，然后一次又一次地被那些仍然掌握权力并深谙体制运作的老恐龙们碾压。

sentences.en: Um, there's a book I read years ago called the ungovernable city about John Lindsay's term as mayor, where it's a little bit fairer to him.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我多年前读过一本书叫《无法治理的城市》，讲的是约翰·林赛的市长任期，那本书对他稍微公平一些。

sentences.en: It still doesn't say he did a good job, but it's a little fair with the things he was dealing with.
sentences.zh: 它并没有说他做得很好，但对当时他所面临的问题处理得稍微公平一点。

sentences.en: But Caro is just, you can tell Caro is writing about current events for the most part in this chapter because he is writing without a sense of distance.
sentences.zh: 但卡罗就是……你可以看出卡罗在这一章中大部分时间是在写时事，因为他写的时候缺乏一种距离感。

sentences.en: And these, these events would have happened while he was writing this book, while he's working on it, you know, with it, it's, this is, uh, you know what, less than 10 years.
sentences.zh: 这些事件发生在他写这本书的时候，在他研究它的时候，你知道，这……你知道吗，不到10年。

sentences.en: Within a decade.
sentences.zh: 在十年之内。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，对，对，没错。

sentences.en: And so you just feel, there's just this feel of this guy has no idea what he's doing.
sentences.zh: 所以你只是感觉到，有一种感觉是这家伙根本不知道自己在做什么。

sentences.en: Like what, uh, and, and I, and probably that feeling of, I like the things this guy stands for, but he has no idea what he's doing and he's going to wreck it.
sentences.zh: 就像什么……而且，我可能也有那种感觉：我喜欢这家伙所代表的东西，但他根本不知道自己在做什么，他会把一切搞砸。

sentences.en: You know, he's not going to be able to do this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他根本做不到。

sentences.en: There's just such a, it's very funny to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说真的非常有趣。

sentences.en: It's, it's, um, we've talked in the past or the other thing I mentioned in the past about, uh, how there are points to this book that remind me of the book eminent Victorians, uh,
sentences.zh: 这……我们过去谈过，或者我过去提到过的另一件事是，这本书中有一些地方让我想起《维多利亚名人传》这本书，

sentences.en: which is like a satirical book in a way about, it's like a burn book about Victorian society.
sentences.zh: 那本书在某种程度上是一本讽刺书，就像一本关于维多利亚时代社会的“黑料书”。

sentences.en: And there are parts in this chapter where it feels like that, where, where Carol's just like, can you believe this?
sentences.zh: 这一章里有些地方感觉就像那样，卡罗就像是说：你敢相信吗？

sentences.en: Like, come on, guy, like, what are you doing?
sentences.zh: 得了吧，伙计，你在干什么？

sentences.en: Uh, and he just, what a dilettante he thinks Mayor Lindsay is.
sentences.zh: 而且他认为林赛市长真是个业余爱好者。

sentences.en: But Lindsay and his team are kind of the, are the, the young hotshots.
sentences.zh: 但林赛和他的团队算是那种年轻的当红人物。

sentences.en: They think they have, you know, they get elected.
sentences.zh: 他们认为他们有……你知道，他们当选了。

sentences.en: They, they think they have control.
sentences.zh: 他们认为自己有控制权。

sentences.en: They think they know how to like, they can push aside all these old people.
sentences.zh: 他们认为他们知道如何……他们可以把这些老家伙都推开。

sentences.en: They believe what, they believe the stuff that textbooks tell you, which is you elect the mayor and the mayor governs the city, which is not necessarily the case.
sentences.zh: 他们相信教科书告诉他们的东西，那就是你选出市长，市长就治理城市，但这并不一定是事实。

sentences.en: But they're like, he's the mayor.
sentences.zh: 但他们觉得：他是市长。

sentences.en: He's in control.
sentences.zh: 他有控制权。

sentences.en: He has the power.
sentences.zh: 他有权力。

sentences.en: He can do whatever he thinks is necessary.
sentences.zh: 他可以做任何他认为必要的事情。

sentences.en: And Carol talks about how Robert Moss is like, great.
sentences.zh: 而卡罗谈到罗伯特·摩西时，就像是说：太好了。

sentences.en: He can say that.
sentences.zh: 他可以这么说。

sentences.en: I know different.
sentences.zh: 但我知道的不一样。

sentences.en: I know who really has power in this, in this relationship.
sentences.zh: 我知道在这个关系中谁才是真正拥有权力的人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And after the string of mayors between LaGuardia and him, who, you know, don't merit full chapters in the book, you know, he kind of thinks like,
sentences.zh: 在拉瓜迪亚（LaGuardia）和他之间的一连串市长之后，你知道，他们不值得在书中占有完整章节，你知道，他有点认为：

sentences.en: I'm the one who would merit a chapter in the power broker that he doesn't know exists.
sentences.zh: 我是那个在《权力掮客》中值得占有一章的人，而他（林赛）甚至不知道这本书的存在。

sentences.en: But he fashions himself as, or sort of fancies himself as the new LaGuardia.
sentences.zh: 但他把自己塑造成，或者说幻想自己是新的拉瓜迪亚。

sentences.en: Like, he takes LaGuardia's picture out of the main rotunda and puts it into his office, takes his desk or something like that.
sentences.zh: 比如，他把拉瓜迪亚的照片从主大厅拿出来放进他的办公室，拿走了他的办公桌之类的。

sentences.en: He takes a LaGuardia desk and then,
sentences.zh: 他拿了一张拉瓜迪亚的桌子，然后，

sentences.en: and Carol uses it as a metaphor where reporters are so eager to take a picture of Lindsay that they climb on top of the desk and it collapses and shatters.
sentences.zh: 卡罗把它用作一个隐喻：记者们太渴望给林赛拍照了，以至于他们爬到桌子上，结果桌子塌了，碎了。

sentences.en: Like, under the weight of his own publicity, you know, his LaGuardia dreams are breaking.
sentences.zh: 就像在自己宣传的重压之下，你知道，他那拉瓜迪亚式的梦想正在破灭。

sentences.en: And the way that Carol talks about him is like he's like a child.
sentences.zh: 卡罗谈论他的方式就像他是个孩子一样。

sentences.en: And he wants to do the things that Carol has been arguing for throughout the book.
sentences.zh: 他想做卡罗在整本书中一直主张的事情。

sentences.en: He wants to use the tribal authority surplus and use it to improve the subways and mass transit.
sentences.zh: 他想利用公共当局的盈余资金，用它来改善地铁和公共交通。

sentences.en: He wants to raise tolls to disincentivize cars in the cities.
sentences.zh: 他想提高通行费以抑制城市里的汽车使用。

sentences.en: But he seems so ignorant to Carol about how to do these things.
sentences.zh: 但在卡罗看来，他似乎对如何做这些事情一无所知。

sentences.en: And Carol says,
sentences.zh: 卡罗说：

sentences.en: the ignorance of some of these men concerning the true nature and powers of public authorities would have been ludicrous if it had not been the city's future that that ignorance was jeopardizing.
sentences.zh: “如果不是因为这种无知危及了城市的未来，那么这些人对公共当局的本质和权力的无知简直是荒谬可笑的。”

sentences.en: Like, I think then maybe that's what makes him really mad is the idea like this is the opportunity.
sentences.zh: 我想，也许这就是让他真正生气的原因，这种想法就像：这是个机会。

sentences.en: Moses is on the ropes.
sentences.zh: 摩西已经走投无路了。

sentences.en: A tough mayor, a mayor who understood the system, could maybe push him out for good or get something out of it.
sentences.zh: 一位强硬的市长，一位了解体制的市长，也许能彻底把他赶走，或者从中得到些什么。

sentences.en: But instead, this baby face comes in.
sentences.zh: 但相反，这个“娃娃脸”进来了。

sentences.en: I mean, a baby face is just a hero.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，娃娃脸只是个英雄。

sentences.en: But this guy who's this newbie, you know, comes in and gets totally owned by the Moses who has been self-owning himself for the past couple chapters.
sentences.zh: 但这个家伙，这个新手，你知道，进来后被摩西彻底玩弄了，而摩西在过去几章里其实一直在自毁前程。

sentences.en: And one of the big things that he wants to do, and you mentioned this, but it's like this is really notable, is this whole thing where many chapters ago, I can't even remember,
sentences.zh: 他想做的其中一件大事，你提到了这一点，但这真的很值得注意，就是很多章以前——我甚至记不清了——的那整件事，

sentences.en: was to take the surplus from Triborough, feed that into the subway system.
sentences.zh: 就是把三区大桥管理局（Triborough）的盈余资金拿出来，投入到地铁系统中。

sentences.en: You know, treat this as one big, you know, dynamic design system that includes cars and bridges and subways and light rail and treats them as one thing,
sentences.zh: 你知道，把这当作一个巨大的、动态的设计系统来对待，包括汽车、桥梁、地铁和轻轨，把它们视为一体，

sentences.en: merging it into this new MTA.
sentences.zh: 将其合并到这个新的大都会运输署（MTA）中。

sentences.en: This is really what the city needed decades and decades ago.
sentences.zh: 这确实是几十年前城市所需要的。

sentences.en: And this is a fight worth having.
sentences.zh: 这是一场值得进行的战斗。

sentences.en: And Lindsay just thinks that this is like, he could just do it.
sentences.zh: 而林赛只是认为这就像……他可以直接做这件事。

sentences.en: And this is where this idea of like what the Triborough Authority is and what these bond covenants are all about, like that there is a – the Triborough Authority sells bonds,
sentences.zh: 这就是关于三区大桥管理局是什么，以及这些债券契约是关于什么的观点，比如有一个——三区大桥管理局发行债券，

sentences.en: the public owns those bonds, they control the money and get money back in these certain ways.
sentences.zh: 公众拥有这些债券，他们控制资金并以特定的方式收回资金。

sentences.en: And the city government cannot get between that transaction legally.
sentences.zh: 而市政府在法律上无法介入该交易。

sentences.en: It is the most basic constitutional law going back – at that point, what, like 120 years, 170 years?
sentences.zh: 这是最基本的宪法法律，追溯到——在那时，大概120年，170年前？

sentences.en: It's either – I don't remember whether – if it's McCullough versus Maryland or I don't remember what thing establishes contracts or whatever.
sentences.zh: 要么是——我不记得了——如果是麦卡洛克诉马里兰州案，或者我不记得是什么确立了合同之类的东西。

sentences.en: But that a contract is legally binding and cannot be interrupted by the government.
sentences.zh: 但合同具有法律约束力，不能被政府中断。

sentences.en: And so Lindsay is like, we're going to merge Triborough and the Transit Authority.
sentences.zh: 所以林赛说：我们要合并三区大桥管理局和交通管理局。

sentences.en: We're going to use the Triborough money to bail out the subways.
sentences.zh: 我们要用三区大桥管理局的钱来救助地铁。

sentences.en: And Moses is like, uh-uh-uh, I wrote the law.
sentences.zh: 而摩西说：不不不，法律是我写的。

sentences.en: It says in these sacred bondholder covenants that I wrote like a magic spell into the bonds to make them inviolable that that money has to go to paying off the bondholders.
sentences.zh: 我在这些神圣的债券持有人契约中写道，就像在债券中施了魔法一样，使它们不可侵犯，那笔钱必须用于偿还债券持有人。

sentences.en: It cannot go to anything else.
sentences.zh: 它不能用于任何其他用途。

sentences.en: And he also does a song and dance about how, you know, only Triborough has the money and the staff to do these big projects.
sentences.zh: 他还演了一出戏，说你知道，只有三区大桥管理局有钱和员工来做这些大项目。

sentences.en: So maybe I just won't do them.
sentences.zh: 所以也许我就不做了。

sentences.en: And maybe the city will lose out all this power.
sentences.zh: 也许城市会失去所有这些权力。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's classic.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是经典操作。

sentences.en: Classic stuff.
sentences.zh: 经典手法。

sentences.en: Classic Moses move.
sentences.zh: 典型的摩西式举动。

sentences.en: He's still got it.
sentences.zh: 他宝刀未老。

sentences.en: He's still doing it.
sentences.zh: 他还在这么做。

sentences.en: And Robert Carroll points out that Lindsay could have cut Moses' power a little bit by removing him from the arterial representative poSt.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·卡罗指出，林赛本可以通过将摩西从动脉代表职位上撤下来，稍微削弱他的权力。

sentences.en: It's an informal poSt.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非正式职位。

sentences.en: All he has to do is send him a letter saying, I don't want you to do this anymore.
sentences.zh: 他所要做的就是给他发一封信，说：我不想让你再做这个了。

sentences.en: And he would not have any more.
sentences.zh: 他就不会再有权力了。

sentences.en: But the Lindsay administration does not really understand the power that comes from that and how the two reinforce each other.
sentences.zh: 但林赛政府并不真正理解由此带来的权力，以及两者是如何相互强化的。

sentences.en: And they think only the Triborough post matters.
sentences.zh: 他们认为只有三区大桥管理局的职位才重要。

sentences.en: They're so focused on this.
sentences.zh: 他们太专注于这一点了。

sentences.en: And they're like, we can do it.
sentences.zh: 他们心想：我们可以做到。

sentences.en: We're going to get rid of him.
sentences.zh: 我们要除掉他。

sentences.en: And Lindsay sends his transportation aide, Arthur E.
sentences.zh: 林赛派出了他的交通助理亚瑟·E·帕尔默（Arthur E. Palmer），

sentences.en: Palmer, not as great a name as some of the other ones, but I like that he has the middle initial E.
sentences.zh: 名字不如其他一些人响亮，但我喜欢他中间名首字母是E。

sentences.en: He goes, Moses, you're going to resign.
sentences.zh: 他去说：摩西，你要辞职。

sentences.en: And Moses responds with a series of lectures about how powerful he is.
sentences.zh: 摩西回应了一系列关于他有多么强大的演讲。

sentences.en: And Carol talks about this slow dawning on Palmer where it's like, oh, this is not the situation that we thought it was going to be.
sentences.zh: 卡罗谈到了帕尔默那种缓慢的觉醒，就像是：哦，这根本不是我们想象中的那种情况。

sentences.en: And so Lindsay is like, well, OK, we can't fire you.
sentences.zh: 所以林赛说：好吧，好吧，我们不能解雇你。

sentences.en: But we'll leave the surpluses alone if you drop your opposition to this merger between Triborough and the Transit Authority.
sentences.zh: 但如果你放弃对三区大桥管理局和交通管理局合并的反对，我们就不会动那些盈余资金。

sentences.en: And Moses is like, that's the emptiest of threats.
sentences.zh: 摩西说：那是空洞的威胁。

sentences.en: You have to leave them alone.
sentences.zh: 你必须不动它们。

sentences.en: Like, it doesn't matter what I do.
sentences.zh: 就像，我做什么并不重要。

sentences.en: I can do whatever I want.
sentences.zh: 我可以做任何我想做的事。

sentences.en: He has all the power.
sentences.zh: 他拥有所有的权力。

sentences.en: And he thinks the Lindsay people are so dumb.
sentences.zh: 他认为林赛的人太蠢了。

sentences.en: He just thinks they're such idiots for taking this long to realize where the power actually lies.
sentences.zh: 他只是觉得他们花这么长时间才意识到权力实际上在哪里，真是太白痴了。

sentences.en: And ultimately, Moses is like, I'll tell you what, we'll merge them together.
sentences.zh: 最终，摩西说：我告诉你吧，我们把它们合并在一起。

sentences.en: We'll make a new transportation authority.
sentences.zh: 我们将建立一个新的交通管理局。

sentences.en: I will run it.
sentences.zh: 我会去执行它。

sentences.en: Take it or leave it.
sentences.zh: 接受还是拒绝，随你便。

sentences.en: That's the only option on the table.
sentences.zh: 这是目前唯一的选择。

sentences.en: And Lindsay is not going to take that option.
sentences.zh: 而林赛并不打算接受这个选择。

sentences.en: They don't want to give Robert Moses more power.
sentences.zh: 他们不想给罗伯特·摩西更多的权力。

sentences.en: He's a dinosaur.
sentences.zh: 他是个老古董了。

sentences.en: They want to get rid of him.
sentences.zh: 他们想除掉他。

sentences.en: And they just can't seem to figure out how to – and maybe it's partly the way that Caro is presenting it.
sentences.zh: 但他们似乎就是想不出办法——也许部分原因是卡罗呈现这件事的方式。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But it does seem like a group of children trying to knock down a professional wrestler and just not seem to realize that he weighs three times all of them put together.
sentences.zh: 但这看起来确实像是一群孩子试图打倒一名职业摔跤手，却完全没意识到他的体重是他们所有人加起来的三倍。

sentences.en: And they just can't – they're not going to be able to do it.
sentences.zh: 他们就是无法——他们根本做不到。

sentences.en: And so this all comes to a head in Albany where they sort of make these cases to Governor Rockefeller.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切在奥尔巴尼达到了顶点，他们在那里向洛克菲勒州长陈述了这些理由。

sentences.en: And what's clear is when these young punks come in and try to present their case, they're just so outmatched because not only is there Robert Moses there to sort of give his side,
sentences.zh: 显而易见的是，当这些年轻的愣头青进来试图陈述他们的理由时，他们完全不是对手，因为不仅有罗伯特·摩西在那里陈述他的一方，

sentences.en: former governors are there to – like on Moses' side.
sentences.zh: 前任州长们也站在摩西这一边。

sentences.en: And everyone is basically on Moses' side.
sentences.zh: 基本上每个人都站在摩西这一边。

sentences.en: And it's such a classic trap because the people in Albany are like, Lindsay, why don't you come up and have a casual discussion with us about this bill,
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常经典的陷阱，因为奥尔巴尼的人会说，林赛，你为什么不来和我们随便讨论一下这个法案呢，

sentences.en: about merging this stuff because it needs state approval anyway.
sentences.zh: 关于合并这些东西，因为无论如何都需要州政府的批准。

sentences.en: And he goes, yeah.
sentences.zh: 他说，好啊。

sentences.en: And he has guys go up.
sentences.zh: 于是他派人去了。

sentences.en: And then they just see the list of speakers when they get there that are scheduled for the date.
sentences.zh: 当他们到达那里时，看到预定当天的发言人名单，

sentences.en: And it's like, yeah, Moses, Dewey, Wagner, like all these major players who are going to testify.
sentences.zh: 就像是，天哪，摩西、杜威、瓦格纳，所有这些即将作证的大人物都在。

sentences.en: And Caro takes such – he takes a couple of pages.
sentences.zh: 卡罗花了很大的篇幅——他用了好几页纸。

sentences.en: He really goes into great depth,
sentences.zh: 他真的写得非常深入，

sentences.en: just luxuriating in the moment when Lindsay realizes he's been tricked and Robert Moses walks into the room and forces Lindsay to shake his hand in front of the reporters.
sentences.zh: 沉浸在林赛意识到自己被耍了，而罗伯特·摩西走进房间，强迫林赛在记者面前与他握手的那一刻。

sentences.en: And while Lindsay is testifying about how great this bill would be, Moses is literally stifling laughter in the room.
sentences.zh: 当林赛还在作证说这个法案有多棒时，摩西在房间里简直是在强忍笑意。

sentences.en: And then Lindsay rushes out and heads right back to New York City because he doesn't want to be there as this parade of the power brokers kind of goes on.
sentences.zh: 然后林赛匆忙离开，直接回到了纽约市，因为他不想待在那里看着这群权势掮客的游行继续下去。

sentences.en: And they just tear the Lindsay idea to shreds and support Moses.
sentences.zh: 他们把林赛的想法撕得粉碎，转而支持摩西。

sentences.en: And Caro gets very catty here where he's like,
sentences.zh: 卡罗在这里写得非常刻薄，他说，

sentences.en: it's too bad John Lindsay didn't stick around because he might have been able to finally discover who the power brokers he had been complaining about all this time actually were because he had no idea who he was talking about.
sentences.zh: 真可惜约翰·林赛没有留下来，因为他本可以最终发现他一直抱怨的那些权势掮客到底是谁，因为他根本不知道自己在谈论谁。

sentences.en: Like it's – and then Moses is like he just – he spends a few more days just kind of like going even overboard, having people attack the mayor's transit merger legislation.
sentences.zh: 就像是——然后摩西又多花了几天时间，甚至有点过火地让人去攻击市长的交通合并立法。

sentences.en: And it never makes it out of committee.
sentences.zh: 结果它甚至没能走出委员会。

sentences.en: It's such a total defeat of Lindsay in Caro's telling and really the last moment where Moses has that kind of power and that kind of victory, you know, in his career.
sentences.zh: 在卡罗的叙述中，这是林赛的彻底失败，也是摩西职业生涯中最后一次拥有那种权力和那种胜利的时刻，你知道的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, this is real – this is kind of it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这真的是——这算是终局了。

sentences.en: Like he calls in all of his favors, you know.
sentences.zh: 他动用了所有人情，你知道的。

sentences.en: He's still presented as the Moses kind of before the fair in terms of his like his sort of character being beyond reproach that if anything needs to get built,
sentences.zh: 他仍然被塑造成世博会之前的那个摩西，他的性格无可挑剔，如果有什么东西需要建造，

sentences.en: it would be Moses who had built it anyway.
sentences.zh: 无论如何都会是摩西建造的。

sentences.en: But it's just one of those things that – he does seem to say or Caro seems to suggest that if Lindsay were better at this and he was more charismatic and more supportive of the people,
sentences.zh: 但这就是其中之一——他似乎在说，或者卡罗似乎在暗示，如果林赛在这方面更擅长，更有魅力，更支持民众，

sentences.en: like maybe this could have happened.
sentences.zh: 也许这事儿就能成了。

sentences.en: And if – at this point, if Rockefeller had also gotten on the side, he kind of stays on the fence with this and just sort of waits for it to play out.
sentences.zh: 而且在这一点上，如果洛克菲勒也加入进来，但他在这件事上保持中立，只是等着看事态发展。

sentences.en: He isn't putting his thumb on the scales.
sentences.zh: 他并没有施加影响。

sentences.en: So no one really takes this moment to push him over.
sentences.zh: 所以没有人真正利用这个时刻去推动他。

sentences.en: I think they're waiting for – to see if Lindsay has the juice to do it and he clearly does not.
sentences.zh: 我想他们是在等——看看林赛是否有能力做到，而他显然没有。

sentences.en: I wonder – I bet you're my – and there's – you have this power struggle going on between Rockefeller and Moses, clearly.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇——我敢说你是我的——而且显然，洛克菲勒和摩西之间存在着权力斗争。

sentences.en: And Lindsay is the upstart who thinks that he is also a part of the dynamic but is not necessarily at the same level.
sentences.zh: 而林赛是一个自以为也是这种动态一部分的暴发户，但并不一定处于同一水平。

sentences.en: And so it's true.
sentences.zh: 所以这是真的。

sentences.en: If Rockefeller had liked Lindsay's plan, he probably could have thrown his weight behind it and gotten it through.
sentences.zh: 如果洛克菲勒喜欢林赛的计划，他可能本可以全力支持并使其通过。

sentences.en: But Lindsay makes the mistake of trotting on Rockefeller's territory.
sentences.zh: 但林赛犯了一个错误，那就是在洛克菲勒的地盘上撒野。

sentences.en: Rockefeller already has a big transit plan for the state.
sentences.zh: 洛克菲勒已经为该州制定了一个宏大的交通计划。

sentences.en: So the idea that Lindsay is like, well, here's my plan.
sentences.zh: 所以林赛说，好吧，这是我的计划。

sentences.en: We should do that instead.
sentences.zh: 我们应该改做这个。

sentences.en: Like it's just foolish.
sentences.zh: 这简直太愚蠢了。

sentences.en: It's the kind of thing that a good politician knows ahead of time, like what the other politicians want to do.
sentences.zh: 这是一个优秀的政治家会提前知道的事情，比如其他政治家想做什么。

sentences.en: And it's such a – it's the naivete of him that I think really gets Caro's goat where if he has this charisma and he has public support at the moment but he just has no real understanding of who he needs to ally with,
sentences.zh: 这真是——他的天真真的让卡罗很恼火，如果他有这种魅力，目前也有公众支持，但他只是完全不了解他需要与谁结盟，

sentences.en: how he can sway people really other than this kind of childish idea that once you get elected to office, people have to do what you say.
sentences.zh: 除了这种幼稚的想法，即一旦你当选公职，人们就必须听你的，否则他还能如何真正左右人们。

sentences.en: It's honestly – it's a little similar in some ways although in a – I think a more positive direction in terms of the desired outcome to when – to Trump's first term as president
sentences.zh: 老实说——这在某些方面有点相似，尽管在预期的结果上我认为是一个更积极的方向，与特朗普的第一任总统任期相比，

sentences.en: where he just seemed to kind of think that if you get elected, everyone has to like you and do what you say, which is not the way government works.
sentences.zh: 他似乎认为只要你当选了，每个人都必须喜欢你并听你的，而政府运作方式并非如此。

sentences.en: Government is about forging alliances and sharing goals and sharing motivations or at least overlapping your needs and my needs that we can work together or compromising things.
sentences.zh: 政府是关于建立联盟、分享目标和动机，或者至少是重叠你的需求和我的需求，以便我们能够合作或妥协。

sentences.en: But the version you're taught as a kid is you win an election and then you make the rules and it seems like Lindsay is operating under that.
sentences.zh: 但你小时候学到的版本是，你赢了一场选举，然后你制定规则，而林赛似乎就是这样运作的。

sentences.en: So Moses has this – I always think of it as like what they always call the high watermark of the Confederacy,
sentences.zh: 所以摩西有这个——我总是把它想成他们常说的邦联的最高水位线，

sentences.en: that like one little corner of a fence in Gettysburg, Pennsylvania that the Confederates broke through for a second when they charged
sentences.zh: 就像宾夕法尼亚州葛底斯堡围栏的一个小角落，邦联军队在冲锋时突破了一秒钟，

sentences.en: and that was the farthest north that the Confederate Army ever got.
sentences.zh: 那是邦联军队到达的最北端。

sentences.en: Like that's what I think about that with this because he has this support.
sentences.zh: 这就是我想到他时所想到的，因为他拥有这种支持。

sentences.en: Then in July of that year, 1966, there's a big 30th anniversary celebration for the Triborough Bridge.
sentences.zh: 然后在1966年7月，三区大桥举行了盛大的30周年庆典。

sentences.en: They bus in 3,500 kids and give them lunch.
sentences.zh: 他们用巴士运来了3500名孩子，并请他们吃午餐。

sentences.en: They have a boxed book called 30 Years of Achievement that they put out and Moses goes,
sentences.zh: 他们有一本名为《成就的30年》的盒装书，摩西说，

sentences.en: we do have a surplus of money in Triborough.
sentences.zh: 我们的三区大桥确实有盈余资金。

sentences.en: It's going to go to improving our bridges that we own already.
sentences.zh: 它将用于改善我们已经拥有的桥梁。

sentences.en: And they close the bridge for the ceremony to drivers for a half hour.
sentences.zh: 他们为了仪式将大桥对司机关闭了半小时。

sentences.en: And Cairo just describes these thousands of drivers sitting in the sun in their cars waiting for the bridge to open back up again.
sentences.zh: 卡罗描述了成千上万的司机坐在阳光下的车里，等待大桥重新开放。

sentences.en: And that really is that high watermark, this last celebration of his power.
sentences.zh: 那确实是最高水位线，是他权力的最后一次庆典。

sentences.en: And at the end of the ceremony, literally while Moses –
sentences.zh: 在仪式结束时，就在摩西——

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个。

sentences.en: Well, he's saying goodbye to guests.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他正在和客人们告别。

sentences.en: He's saying goodbye to guests and a letter arrives from the mayor saying,
sentences.zh: 他正在和客人们告别，这时市长寄来了一封信，说，

sentences.en: hey, you've been dismissed as arterial highways representative.
sentences.zh: 嘿，你已经被解除了动脉公路代表的职务。

sentences.en: You're not going to do that anymore.
sentences.zh: 你以后不用再做那个了。

sentences.en: And Cairo says that would have been a powerful thing to do earlier.
sentences.zh: 卡罗说，如果早点这样做会很有力。

sentences.en: Now it doesn't matter anymore.
sentences.zh: 现在已经无所谓了。

sentences.en: He just has the Triborough Authority presidency.
sentences.zh: 他只剩下三区管理局主席的职位了。

sentences.en: He used to have 12 jobs.
sentences.zh: 他曾经有12份工作。

sentences.en: This is the only one job he has.
sentences.zh: 这是他唯一剩下的工作。

sentences.en: And Lindsay puts one of his guys on the Triborough board when a position opens up.
sentences.zh: 当有一个职位空缺时，林赛把他的一个人安插进了三区董事会。

sentences.en: But it's still every vote is two to one, Moses and his guy versus this other guy.
sentences.zh: 但每一票仍然是二对一，摩西和他的手下对阵另一个人。

sentences.en: And so he wins every vote.
sentences.zh: 所以他赢得了每一票。

sentences.en: And he says, well, even if I don't have that arterial representative post anymore,
sentences.zh: 他说，好吧，即使我不再担任那个动脉代表的职位，

sentences.en: my plans are the only ones that can be used.
sentences.zh: 我的计划是唯一可行的。

sentences.en: I have the support of the power brokers.
sentences.zh: 我有权势掮客的支持。

sentences.en: And his term at Triborough Head doesn't end until 1970, by which time there may be another mayor anyway.
sentences.zh: 他在三区负责人的任期直到1970年才结束，到那时可能已经有另一位市长了。

sentences.en: It doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 这没关系。

sentences.en: He is feeling still.
sentences.zh: 他依然感觉良好。

sentences.en: He's been reduced to one poSt.
sentences.zh: 他已经被削减到一个职位了。

sentences.en: The fair was a disaster.
sentences.zh: 世博会是一场灾难。

sentences.en: But he still feels so arrogant.
sentences.zh: 但他仍然感到非常傲慢。

sentences.en: He does not care what Lindsay tries to do.
sentences.zh: 他不在乎林赛试图做什么。

sentences.en: Lindsay is meaningless to him.
sentences.zh: 林赛对他来说毫无意义。

sentences.en: But there's someone far more powerful than Mayor Lindsay who is finally ready to move against Moses.
sentences.zh: 但有一个比林赛市长强大得多的人终于准备好对摩西采取行动了。

sentences.en: There's someone who has finally had their fill of Moses.
sentences.zh: 有一个人终于受够了摩西。

sentences.en: Who is that person, Roman?
sentences.zh: 那个人是谁，罗曼？

sentences.en: I mean, this is Governor Rockefeller who's going to come back in to be the person who finally puts Robert Moses out of a job.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是洛克菲勒州长，他将回来成为最终让罗伯特·摩西失业的人。

sentences.en: And that is the main subject of the next chapter.
sentences.zh: 这就是下一章的主题。

sentences.en: It's called The Last Stand, Chapter 49.
sentences.zh: 它叫《最后的抵抗》，第49章。

sentences.en: And this is where Rockefeller, you know, after letting Mayor Lindsay kind of flounder around a bit,
sentences.zh: 这就是洛克菲勒，你知道，在让林赛市长折腾了一阵子之后，

sentences.en: maybe soften up Moses in some ways.
sentences.zh: 也许在某些方面削弱了摩西。

sentences.en: I don't know, maybe for his own amusement.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，也许是为了他自己的娱乐。

sentences.en: I don't know why he didn't step in earlier.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他为什么没有早点介入。

sentences.en: But Rockefeller finally steps in.
sentences.zh: 但洛克菲勒终于介入了。

sentences.en: And what he's really trying to do is take over transit.
sentences.zh: 他真正想做的是接管交通。

sentences.en: Like he'd already given his brother control of the parks.
sentences.zh: 就像他已经把公园的控制权交给了他的兄弟一样。

sentences.en: And now he has this vision of this massive overhaul of transportation.
sentences.zh: 现在他有了对交通进行大规模改革的愿景。

sentences.en: And he knows it's going to be incredibly expensive.
sentences.zh: 他知道这将非常昂贵。

sentences.en: And the person who has all the money, the person who controls the money that he wants to control to do this overhaul of state transportation is Robert Moses.
sentences.zh: 而拥有所有资金的人，控制着他想要控制的资金来进行州交通改革的人，就是罗伯特·摩西。

sentences.en: He wants Robert Moses' money.
sentences.zh: 他想要罗伯特·摩西的钱。

sentences.en: He wants to control it.
sentences.zh: 他想控制它。

sentences.en: He wants Robert Moses' money.
sentences.zh: 他想要罗伯特·摩西的钱。

sentences.en: There's two.
sentences.zh: 有两个。

sentences.en: It's going to cost him at least $6.5 billion for the first five years of building this massive transportation system that he wants for the state.
sentences.zh: 他想要为该州建立这个庞大的交通系统，前五年至少要花费65亿美元。

sentences.en: This integrated system of mass transit and roads.
sentences.zh: 这个集大众交通和道路于一体的系统。

sentences.en: And there's only two organizations that have it.
sentences.zh: 只有两个组织拥有它。

sentences.en: There's the Port Authority and there's Tri-Port Authority.
sentences.zh: 一个是港务局，一个是三区管理局。

sentences.en: Port Authority is half New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 港务局有一半属于新泽西州。

sentences.en: He doesn't want anything to do with that.
sentences.zh: 他不想和那有任何关系。

sentences.en: He does not want to have to deal with the government of New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 他不想和新泽西州政府打交道。

sentences.en: They'd be like, hey, yeah, we can give you that money.
sentences.zh: 他们会说，嘿，是的，我们可以给你那笔钱。

sentences.en: You know, maybe he's got some nice buildings over in Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 你知道，也许他在曼哈顿有一些漂亮的建筑。

sentences.en: Maybe we could have some of those.
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以得到其中的一些。

sentences.en: He doesn't want – he doesn't have to deal with that.
sentences.zh: 他不想——他不必处理那个。

sentences.en: This is me.
sentences.zh: 这是我。

sentences.en: I come from New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 我来自新泽西。

sentences.en: I remember my dad referring to at one point the governor of New Jersey and being like, yeah, he's a little slimy, but you got to accept a little bit of that.
sentences.zh: 我记得我父亲曾提到新泽西州长，说，是的，他有点滑头，但你必须接受一点点那种东西。

sentences.en: And it's like that was just – that's the New Jersey way.
sentences.zh: 就像那是——那是新泽西的方式。

sentences.en: Rockefeller's like, Triborough has this money.
sentences.zh: 洛克菲勒说，三区有这笔钱。

sentences.en: There's one person standing in the way of me getting it, and that is Robert Moses.
sentences.zh: 有一个人挡在我得到它的路上，那就是罗伯特·摩西。

sentences.en: And Caro sees this as just an inevitable clash of personalities.
sentences.zh: 卡罗认为这只是一场不可避免的性格冲突。

sentences.en: Rockefeller and Moses are both too arrogant.
sentences.zh: 洛克菲勒和摩西都太傲慢了。

sentences.en: They're too used to getting their own way.
sentences.zh: 他们太习惯于按自己的方式行事。

sentences.en: They cannot coexist for long.
sentences.zh: 他们不可能长期共存。

sentences.en: It's impossible.
sentences.zh: 这不可能。

sentences.en: And in the past, Moses was irremovable, and Caro reminds us of the reasons.
sentences.zh: 在过去，摩西是不可撼动的，卡罗提醒我们原因。

sentences.en: He had all these jobs that interlocked with each other.
sentences.zh: 他拥有所有这些相互交织的工作。

sentences.en: He had so many sources of money.
sentences.zh: 他有太多的资金来源。

sentences.en: The staggered term limits, he couldn't be replaced all at once.
sentences.zh: 错开的任期限制，他不能一次被全部替换。

sentences.en: He had this city-state combined power base, so the mayor couldn't remove him because he needed the state's help, and the state couldn't remove him because they needed the city.
sentences.zh: 他拥有这种城市与州结合的权力基础，所以市长不能免除他，因为他需要州的帮助，而州不能免除他，因为他们需要城市。

sentences.en: Each of his posts, it was beautifully constructed.
sentences.zh: 他的每一个职位，都构建得非常精美。

sentences.en: It was fiendish in its intricacies.
sentences.zh: 其复杂程度简直令人发指。

sentences.en: But now, as we know, he's resigned or been fired from all but one post,
sentences.zh: 但现在，我们知道，他已经辞职或被解雇，只剩下一个职位，

sentences.en: and he has so much less money at hand to fight with as a result of that.
sentences.zh: 因此他手头用来战斗的资金少了很多。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He has less money and just that whole idea of him.
sentences.zh: 他钱少了，而且就是关于他的整个想法。

sentences.en: Because Caro describes it as like resigning from one has all this power to inflict harm using his authority on other posts.
sentences.zh: 因为卡罗将其描述为辞去一个职位，却拥有利用他在其他职位上的权威来造成伤害的所有权力。

sentences.en: And so it was sort of impossible.
sentences.zh: 所以这在某种程度上是不可能的。

sentences.en: Now, Trineborough happens to be kind of the most powerful one because it has all the money.
sentences.zh: 现在，三区大桥管理局恰好是其中最强大的一个，因为它掌握着所有的资金。

sentences.en: It has this direct connection with the bondholders, so therefore, like, the city and state really can't intervene.
sentences.zh: 它与债券持有人有着直接联系，因此，市政府和州政府实际上无法干预。

sentences.en: And they can't oversee any of his actions.
sentences.zh: 他们也无法监督他的任何行动。

sentences.en: His actions are both private and also outside of their immediate flow control.
sentences.zh: 他的行动既是私人的，也超出了他们直接的流程控制。

sentences.en: So it is – if you're going to be left with one, that's the one.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你非要保留一个，那就是这一个。

sentences.en: That's the one to be left with.
sentences.zh: 这就是那个值得保留的。

sentences.en: And it's possible he's still building that dam somewhere.
sentences.zh: 而且他可能还在某个地方建那座大坝。

sentences.en: Nobody knows.
sentences.zh: 没人知道。

sentences.en: Nobody cares.
sentences.zh: 没人关心。

sentences.en: Like, it's happening off in another world.
sentences.zh: 就像是发生在另一个世界一样。

sentences.en: But that's the one you want to have.
sentences.zh: 但这正是你想要拥有的那个。

sentences.en: But here's the real thing about the fact that the governor is Nelson Rockefeller.
sentences.zh: 但关于纳尔逊·洛克菲勒担任州长这一事实，真正关键的是这一点。

sentences.en: Because, I mean, and this is like – this is sort of like just like fate coming together in a certain way to have this unfold.
sentences.zh: 因为，我的意思是，这就像是——这就像是命运以某种方式交织在一起，才让这一切得以展开。

sentences.en: Because it just so happens that Nelson Rockefeller is part of the richest family in the world pretty much, and his brother owns Chase Bank.
sentences.zh: 因为恰好纳尔逊·洛克菲勒几乎是世界上最富有家族的一员，而他的兄弟拥有大通银行。

sentences.en: Now,
sentences.zh: 现在，

sentences.en: why that matters is because even though you're a bondholder and you have some right to have this relationship with the tribal authority through their bonds and being paid back,
sentences.zh: 之所以这很重要，是因为即使你是债券持有人，并且你有权通过债券与部落管理局建立这种关系并获得偿还，

sentences.en: when something goes wrong with that relationship, you don't actually – it's not feasible for you to sue tribal authority for changing the terMs.
sentences.zh: 但当这种关系出现问题时，你实际上并没有——你不可能因为条款变更而起诉部落管理局。

sentences.en: Really, what happens is that you have this entity that represents you as the bondholder.
sentences.zh: 实际上，发生的情况是，你有一个代表你作为债券持有人的实体。

sentences.en: You have the bondholder's trustee who will handle any of these suits for you.
sentences.zh: 你有债券持有人的受托人，他会为你处理任何此类诉讼。

sentences.en: Because also, if one bondholder sues but not everybody sues, that undermines his suit.
sentences.zh: 因为同样，如果只有一个债券持有人起诉，而不是所有人起诉，那会削弱他的诉讼力度。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So you need one shared entity that is overseeing the interests of the bondholders.
sentences.zh: 所以你需要一个共同的实体来监督债券持有人的利益。

sentences.en: Of the bondholders.
sentences.zh: 监督债券持有人的利益。

sentences.en: And that entity is Chase Bank, who is run by the governor's brother.
sentences.zh: 而那个实体就是大通银行，由州长的兄弟经营。

sentences.en: And the trustee was the Chase Manhattan Bank, and the Chase Manhattan was the only large bank in the United States.
sentences.zh: 受托人是大通曼哈顿银行，而大通曼哈顿是美国唯一的大型银行。

sentences.en: The state still controlled by a single family, the governors.
sentences.zh: 该州仍然由一个家族，即州长家族所控制。

sentences.en: Like, this is – it is – we'll get – each time, it's like a cosmic conjunction that allows this.
sentences.zh: 这就像是——它是——我们每次都会提到，这就像是一种宇宙的巧合，才促成了这一切。

sentences.en: So here's how it plays out.
sentences.zh: 所以事情是这样发展的。

sentences.en: January 4th, 1967.
We've covered a lot of time on the show.
sentences.zh: 我们在节目中已经涵盖了很长一段时间。

sentences.en: It's 1967 all of a sudden.
sentences.zh: 突然之间就到了1967年。

sentences.en: Man will be walking on the moon in just a couple years, you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道，再过几年人类就要登上月球了。

sentences.en: And people – well, we were talking about a time when people didn't even have cars.
sentences.zh: 而且人们——好吧，我们谈论的是一个人们甚至还没有汽车的时代。

sentences.en: And Rockefeller asked the legislature and the voters to approve a $2 billion bond issue for transportation construction.
sentences.zh: 洛克菲勒要求立法机关和选民批准一项20亿美元的交通建设债券发行计划。

sentences.en: And part of that would be merging all of the city and state transit authorities into one metropolitan commuter transportation authority.
sentences.zh: 其中一部分是将所有市和州的交通管理局合并为一个大都会通勤交通管理局。

sentences.en: Eventually, this will turn into the MTA.
sentences.zh: 最终，这将演变成大都会运输署（MTA）。

sentences.en: It will merge together as the MTA, the Metropolitan Transportation Authority.
sentences.zh: 它将合并为MTA，即大都会运输署。

sentences.en: I used to think it was transit, but it's transportation.
sentences.zh: 我以前以为是交通（transit），但其实是运输（transportation）。

sentences.en: Under the control of his aide, Ronan, who is a former college professor who we may have mentioned before, Moses hates him.
sentences.zh: 在他的助手罗南的控制下，罗南是一位前大学教授，我们之前可能提到过，摩西很讨厌他。

sentences.en: He doesn't like him at all.
sentences.zh: 他一点也不喜欢他。

sentences.en: Yeah, he thinks he's a sort of like – he's just like an egghead, a dude like who knows the academics of transportation but knows nothing else.
sentences.zh: 是的，他认为他只是一个——他就像是一个书呆子，一个只懂运输学术理论却一窍不通的家伙。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And, Roman, does that offend you at all since his name is almost – his last name, Ronan, is almost your first name?
sentences.zh: 那么，罗曼，这会冒犯到你吗？因为他的名字几乎——他的姓氏罗南，几乎就是你的名字？

sentences.en: No, I'm okay with it.
sentences.zh: 不，我没关系。

sentences.en: Okay, that's fine.
sentences.zh: 好的，那没问题。

sentences.en: I still have the RM bond with Robert Moses, if I know.
sentences.zh: 如果我知道的话，我和罗伯特·摩西之间还有那种RM的纽带。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's true.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是真的。

sentences.en: That's a good point.
sentences.zh: 说得好。

sentences.en: Oh, you're all over this book.
sentences.zh: 哦，你对这本书真是了如指掌。

sentences.en: This is amazing.
sentences.zh: 这太神奇了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it always makes me think of Ronan the Accuser, who is a Marvel villain who was in the first Guardians of the Galaxy movie.
sentences.zh: 而且这总让我想起指控者罗南，他是漫威的反派，出现在第一部《银河护卫队》电影中。

sentences.en: And the other thing is Rockefeller, he has a budget shortfall in his projections for the state.
sentences.zh: 另一件事是洛克菲勒，他在州的预算预测中出现了缺口。

sentences.en: He's already factored in millions of dollars from this bond issue to shore up the budget.
sentences.zh: 他已经将这次债券发行带来的数百万美元计入了预算，以支撑财政。

sentences.en: So if this doesn't pass, he's going to be in a lot of trouble.
sentences.zh: 所以如果这不能通过，他将陷入大麻烦。

sentences.en: He's going to have to enact huge tax increases.
sentences.zh: 他将不得不实施大规模的增税。

sentences.en: He plans on running for president in 1968, and being a Republican, at this time, Republicans – it was a bigger tent than it is now.
sentences.zh: 他计划在1968年竞选总统，作为共和党人，在当时，共和党的包容性比现在要大。

sentences.en: You still have these liberal spending Republicans,
sentences.zh: 你仍然有这些主张自由支出的共和党人，

sentences.en: but it's going to hurt him with the other conservatives when he's running for president if people see him as a guy who just spends a lot of money and taxes.
sentences.zh: 但如果人们认为他是一个只会大肆挥霍和加税的人，这在他竞选总统时会损害他在其他保守派眼中的形象。

sentences.en: So the legislature approves it.
sentences.zh: 所以立法机关批准了它。

sentences.en: The referendum has to be voted on by the people of the state, and they're getting a little tired of Rockefeller's big spending ways.
sentences.zh: 全民公投必须由该州人民投票决定，而他们对洛克菲勒的大手大脚已经有点厌倦了。

sentences.en: Not everybody in New York State is a Rockefeller used to spending lots of money.
sentences.zh: 并不是纽约州的每个人都像洛克菲勒那样习惯于挥金如土。

sentences.en: And the unions, they still support Moses as the only guy who can competently build anything in the region.
sentences.zh: 工会仍然支持摩西，认为他是该地区唯一能胜任任何建设工作的人。

sentences.en: He's brought them so many jobs.
sentences.zh: 他为他们带来了如此多的工作岗位。

sentences.en: He's brought them so much money.
sentences.zh: 他为他们带来了如此多的财富。

sentences.en: And Ronan tells the press, you know what?
sentences.zh: 罗南告诉媒体，你知道吗？

sentences.en: If we merge everybody into this organization, it's going to lead to this huge surplus in rail and toll revenue.
sentences.zh: 如果我们把所有人都合并到这个组织中，将会带来巨大的铁路和通行费盈余。

sentences.en: And Moses, he's like, that doesn't seem right to me.
sentences.zh: 摩西觉得，这对我来说似乎不对劲。

sentences.en: And he does some of his figuring on yellow legal pads.
sentences.zh: 于是他在黄色法律便签纸上做了一些计算。

sentences.en: The single greatest way to brainstorm or work out any problem is on a yellow legal pad.
sentences.zh: 头脑风暴或解决任何问题的最好方法就是在黄色法律便签纸上进行。

sentences.en: And Robert Moses – this is where – one of the few places where Robert Moses and I really overlap is our love of working on yellow legal pads.
sentences.zh: 而罗伯特·摩西——这是为数不多我和罗伯特·摩西有交集的地方，就是我们都喜欢在黄色法律便签纸上工作。

sentences.en: He does the figures, and he's smart enough to see that his mind is still so agile and so comprehensive that he can see these numbers don't add up.
sentences.zh: 他算出了数字，他足够聪明，能看出他的思维依然敏捷且全面，他能看出这些数字根本对不上。

sentences.en: This merger is going to lead to huge deficits.
sentences.zh: 这次合并将导致巨大的赤字。

sentences.en: It will never save the state from having to cover the subway's money probleMs.
sentences.zh: 它永远无法挽救州政府，使其免于承担地铁的资金问题。

sentences.en: It's just the numbers don't add up.
sentences.zh: 这些数字根本对不上。

sentences.en: And the Rockefeller authorities, the state authorities, they've been paying off bondholders from state revenues, not their own revenues.
sentences.zh: 洛克菲勒的当局，即州政府当局，一直是用州政府的收入而不是他们自己的收入来偿还债券持有人。

sentences.en: So Moses does all this calculation, da-da-da-da, and he shows by 1972 debt service for the state will be $500 million, which is this huge burden for the taxpayers,
sentences.zh: 所以摩西做了所有这些计算，哒哒哒哒，他证明到1972年，州政府的债务偿还额将达到5亿美元，这对纳税人来说是一个巨大的负担，

sentences.en: and that eventually this big merger plan will cost the state a billion dollars just in interest payments.
sentences.zh: 而且最终这个庞大的合并计划仅利息支出就会让州政府损失十亿美元。

sentences.en: The interest payments will be so enormous because they have to borrow so much money.
sentences.zh: 利息支出将非常巨大，因为他们必须借入如此多的资金。

sentences.en: And Moses knows if he reveals this truth, it will destroy the governor's plans.
sentences.zh: 摩西知道，如果他揭露这个真相，它将摧毁州长的计划。

sentences.en: It will just wreck them.
sentences.zh: 它会彻底毁掉它们。

sentences.en: He will have defeated Rockefeller in this way.
sentences.zh: 他将以这种方式击败洛克菲勒。

sentences.en: But Moses is not a guy who just wants to stomp on his enemies.
sentences.zh: 但摩西不是那种只想践踏敌人的人。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: He wants power.
sentences.zh: 他想要权力。

sentences.en: He wants power.
sentences.zh: 他想要权力。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so he sort of presents this and says, well, I won't let anyone else know about this sort of thing if you make me part of this new merge entity.
sentences.zh: 所以他把这些展示出来并说，好吧，如果你让我加入这个新的合并实体，我就不会让其他人知道这件事。

sentences.en: He's gotten to the point where he kind of he recognizes that his time as a completely independent entity is coming to an end.
sentences.zh: 他已经意识到，他作为一个完全独立实体的时代即将结束。

sentences.en: And maybe it's because of that leverage from Chase Bank, because that's never really – no one really pulls that lever, you know what I mean,
sentences.zh: 也许是因为来自大通银行的杠杆作用，因为那从来没有真正——没有人真正动用过那个杠杆，你明白我的意思吗，

sentences.en: to muscle in on the Chase Bank part of it.
sentences.zh: 去插手大通银行那部分事务。

sentences.en: I mean, to be honest, I think there's something about it that Tua Rockefeller would feel gauche to be that open and that clear on it.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我认为洛克菲勒会觉得那样做太露骨、太直白，显得有些粗俗。

sentences.en: You know, like this – they come from – they both – both of these guys come from moneyed backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这——他们来自——这两个人都来自富裕的背景。

sentences.en: You know, Moses is from kind of like the upper middle class, and Rockefeller is from the richest family in the history of the world.
sentences.zh: 你知道，摩西来自中上阶层，而洛克菲勒来自历史上最富有的家族。

sentences.en: But there's also a certain amount of like Moses is a brash, loud guy.
sentences.zh: 但也有一定程度的原因是，摩西是一个傲慢、大声嚷嚷的人。

sentences.en: Rockefeller is not.
sentences.zh: 洛克菲勒则不然。

sentences.en: For lack of better comparative terms, I'm just going to say one's Jewish and one's Gentile.
sentences.zh: 由于缺乏更好的比较词，我只想说一个是犹太人，一个是外邦人。

sentences.en: That's just – you know, that's just for lack of better reasons for why.
sentences.zh: 这只是——你知道，这只是因为找不到更好的理由来解释原因。

sentences.en: But they – I think there's probably something in Rockefeller that feels like to pull that lever, to really have that – to show that leverage out would be kind of disgusting,
sentences.zh: 但我认为洛克菲勒内心可能觉得，动用那个杠杆，真正展示那种影响力会让人感到恶心，

sentences.en: you know, would be kind of slimy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，会显得有些卑劣。

sentences.en: And so – but Moses is setting up just in case he needs to, his leverage.
sentences.zh: 所以——但摩西正在为自己设置杠杆，以防万一需要用到。

sentences.en: He tells a reporter, hey, I have some figures to show you.
sentences.zh: 他告诉记者，嘿，我有一些数据要给你看。

sentences.en: I've got some numbers to show you.
sentences.zh: 我有一些数字要给你看。

sentences.en: And he's already made a public statement saying the merger plan is grotesque and it's absurd.
sentences.zh: 而且他已经发表了公开声明，称合并计划是荒谬且可笑的。

sentences.en: And then on March 9th, 1967, they have a private meeting, Moses and Rockefeller.
sentences.zh: 然后在1967年3月9日，摩西和洛克菲勒进行了一次私人会面。

sentences.en: I think it's one of them and each one of their aides, each of them.
sentences.zh: 我想是他们中的一个和各自的一名助手。

sentences.en: And then two days after he said the plan was grotesque and absurd, he goes, I'm fully behind it.
sentences.zh: 而在他说计划荒谬可笑的两天后，他说，我完全支持它。

sentences.en: It's indispensable.
sentences.zh: 它是不可或缺的。

sentences.en: We've got to do this.
sentences.zh: 我们必须这样做。

sentences.en: And it's clear that Rockefeller has promised Moses that he's not going to be pushed out of this system.
sentences.zh: 很明显，洛克菲勒已经向摩西承诺，他不会被踢出这个系统。

sentences.en: And that reporter is like, Moses, you said you had some figures you want to show me?
sentences.zh: 那个记者问，摩西，你说你有数据想给我看？

sentences.en: And Moses is like, yeah, I'll send them to you.
sentences.zh: 摩西说，是的，我会发给你。

sentences.en: I'll send them to you.
sentences.zh: 我会发给你的。

sentences.en: And he never does.
sentences.zh: 但他从来没发。

sentences.en: He just never – it's accomplished what it needed to do.
sentences.zh: 他只是从来没有——它已经达到了预期的目的。

sentences.en: And it seems that Rockefeller has promised Moses a seat on the transit board in exchange for supporting the plan publicly.
sentences.zh: 看来洛克菲勒已经承诺给摩西一个交通委员会的席位，以换取他公开支持该计划。

sentences.en: And Rockefeller's in public.
sentences.zh: 而洛克菲勒在公开场合，

sentences.en: He's like, we want Moses.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们需要摩西。

sentences.en: We want his abilities on that board.
sentences.zh: 我们需要他在那个委员会发挥他的能力。

sentences.en: Again, Moses is an old man by this point.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，摩西此时已经是一位老人了。

sentences.en: He's pushing almost 80.
sentences.zh: 他快80岁了。

sentences.en: But they're like, we need him.
sentences.zh: 但他们说，我们需要他。

sentences.en: And it means that the resources of Tribro are put in the service of lobbying for this.
sentences.zh: 这意味着三区大桥管理局的资源被用于游说支持这项计划。

sentences.en: They fund this campaign.
sentences.zh: 他们资助了这场运动。

sentences.en: They lobby.
sentences.zh: 他们进行游说。

sentences.en: Moses goes out and lobbies hard to the public about these mergers.
sentences.zh: 摩西走出去，向公众大力游说这些合并事宜。

sentences.en: And he lies that the bondholder covenants, these precious sacred things he's been holding over everyone's head that he just held over Lindsay's head in the last chapter,
sentences.zh: 他撒谎说债券持有人的契约，这些他一直悬在每个人头上、在上一章刚悬在林赛头上的珍贵神圣的东西，

sentences.en: he promises that they will be respected even though he knows that it won't be.
sentences.zh: 他承诺它们会得到尊重，尽管他知道事实并非如此。

sentences.en: He knows it's not going to happen.
sentences.zh: 他知道这不会发生。

sentences.en: He is ready, I think, to sell out the bondholders for this last chance to hold on to power.
sentences.zh: 我想，为了这最后一次保住权力的机会，他已经准备好出卖债券持有人了。

sentences.en: And partly because of his help, the referendum passes and the MTA continues today to do a mediocre at best job of coordinating the New York region's mass transit.
sentences.zh: 部分由于他的帮助，公投通过了，而MTA今天仍在以平庸的表现协调纽约地区的公共交通。

sentences.en: But there's still this problem.
sentences.zh: 但问题依然存在。

sentences.en: He said the bondholder covenants would be totally taken care of.
sentences.zh: 他说债券持有人的契约会得到妥善处理。

sentences.en: Is that the case, though, Roman?
sentences.zh: 但事实是这样吗，罗曼？

sentences.en: If I hold some bonds in Tribro, I can just sit back and be rest assured that the money is going to come to me that's owed to me.
sentences.zh: 如果我持有三区大桥管理局的一些债券，我是否可以高枕无忧，确信欠我的钱会如数归还？

sentences.en: Is that going to happen?
sentences.zh: 这会发生吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不会。

sentences.en: I mean, but what's clear is that both sides of this have worked out an understanding so that they're not really – none of this is sort of vigorously pursued.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，但显而易见的是，双方都已经达成了谅解，所以他们并没有真正——这一切都没有被积极地追究。

sentences.en: You know?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Just because everyone here is friends.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为这里每个人都是朋友。

sentences.en: Basically, Chase Bank represents the bondholders.
sentences.zh: 基本上，大通银行代表债券持有人。

sentences.en: Now the interests of Moses and Rockefeller are aligned.
sentences.zh: 现在摩西和洛克菲勒的利益是一致的。

sentences.en: Like, no one wants this to work out.
sentences.zh: 就像，没人希望这件事被揭穿。

sentences.en: And so it ends up being that there's a settlement.
sentences.zh: 所以最终达成了一个和解。

sentences.en: But it's all –
sentences.zh: 但这完全是——

sentences.en: It's all very shadowy.
sentences.zh: 这一切都非常隐晦。

sentences.en: Just to lay the stakes out here, there's this one section here where Carol says,
sentences.zh: 为了说明这里的利害关系，这里有一段卡罗尔说的话，

sentences.en: two things are clear.
sentences.zh: 有两点很清楚。

sentences.en: One, that in the opinion of almost every legal expert on municipal and public authority bonds –
sentences.zh: 第一，几乎每一位市政和公共当局债券领域的法律专家都认为——

sentences.en: this is already the most exciting sentence in the history of the world.
sentences.zh: 这已经是世界历史上最令人兴奋的一句话了。

sentences.en: If the suit had been prosecuted vigorously – because Chase Bank has started bringing suit already.
sentences.zh: 如果诉讼能得到有力推进——因为大通银行已经开始提起诉讼了——

sentences.en: It would have been successful.
sentences.zh: 它本会取得成功。

sentences.en: The merger would have been voided until all its $367,200,000 bonds had been redeemed.
sentences.zh: 合并案本会被撤销，直到其全部3.672亿美元的债券得到赎回。

sentences.en: The Triborough Bridge and Tunnel Authority would have remained an independent, autonomous agency.
sentences.zh: 三区桥梁与隧道管理局本可以保持为一个独立、自治的机构。

sentences.en: And if the authority chose not to redeem its bonds, it would have remained independent and autonomous indefinitely.
sentences.zh: 如果该局选择不赎回债券，它本可以无限期地保持独立和自治。

sentences.en: Two, that the suit was not prosecuted vigorously.
sentences.zh: 第二，诉讼并没有得到有力推进。

sentences.en: Why the suit was not prosecuted vigorously is not known.
sentences.zh: 至于为什么诉讼没有得到有力推进，原因不得而知。

sentences.en: And as you know, Robert Caro hates to say when something's not known.
sentences.zh: 而且如你所知，罗伯特·卡罗最讨厌说“不知道”这类的话。

sentences.en: You have to imagine behind that sentence must have been so many hours of trying to find out from people what exactly happened.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象，在那句话背后，一定花费了无数个小时去向人们打听究竟发生了什么。

sentences.en: Because Chase Bank files suit.
sentences.zh: 因为大通银行提起了诉讼。

sentences.en: Its lawyer, Thomas Dewey, former governor, my other grandmother's most hated politician in her life.
sentences.zh: 其律师托马斯·杜威，前州长，也是我另一位祖母一生中最痛恨的政治家。

sentences.en: After the referendum passes, Governor Rockefeller and his brother, David Rockefeller, president of Chase Bank,
sentences.zh: 在公投通过后，洛克菲勒州长和他的兄弟、大通银行行长戴维·洛克菲勒，

sentences.en: they negotiate a settlement at the governor's house in February of 1968.
sentences.zh: 于1968年2月在州长官邸协商了一项和解协议。

sentences.en: And it's sealed, but we seem to know some of the things in it, that the bondholders agree the merger is constitutional and legal, and the Triborough Board, chaired by Robert Moses,
sentences.zh: 协议内容是保密的，但我们似乎了解其中一些条款：债券持有人同意合并案符合宪法且合法，而由罗伯特·摩西担任主席的三区管理局董事会，

sentences.en: will be supplanted by the MTA Board, chaired by Rockefeller's aide, Ronan.
sentences.zh: 将被由洛克菲勒的助手罗南担任主席的MTA（大都会运输署）董事会所取代。

sentences.en: And with that, the suit is over, and Moses, not knowing it, has been defeated.
sentences.zh: 至此，诉讼结束，而摩西在不知情的情况下，已经被击败了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because Moses, one of the reasons he's agreeing with this, one of the reasons he told his in-house lawyer, don't bother with this suit, don't push too hard,
sentences.zh: 因为摩西之所以同意这一点，他告诉内部律师不要纠结于这场诉讼、不要逼得太紧的原因之一，

sentences.en: is because he has been assured he will be on that MTA Board.
sentences.zh: 是因为他被保证会进入那个MTA董事会。

sentences.en: That he is being pushed up rather than being pushed out.
sentences.zh: 他以为自己是在被提拔，而不是被踢出局。

sentences.en: And Caro says, nobody knows what Chase got in return.
sentences.zh: 卡罗说，没人知道大通银行得到了什么回报。

sentences.en: Nobody knows why the bank dropped this suit for the settlement.
sentences.zh: 没人知道银行为什么为了和解而放弃了诉讼。

sentences.en: And Caro notes that the bank continued to underwrite immensely profitable state bonds from there on.
sentences.zh: 卡罗指出，此后银行继续承销了大量利润丰厚的州债券。

sentences.en: But it's also a fact that the governor's brother runs this bank.
sentences.zh: 但事实也是，州长的兄弟经营着这家银行。

sentences.en: And Caro is like, removing Moses takes literally that the governor of New York be the one man beyond the reach of normal politics,
sentences.zh: 卡罗认为，罢免摩西实际上意味着纽约州州长成为了唯一一个不受常规政治影响的人，

sentences.en: and that the trustee of Triborough's interest be a bank run by that governor's brother.
sentences.zh: 而三区管理局利益的受托人则是一家由该州长兄弟经营的银行。

sentences.en: This is not the way democracy is meant to work.
sentences.zh: 这不是民主应有的运作方式。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it's one of those things that it's kind of like the resignation that happened in the last episode that we talked about.
sentences.zh: 这就像我们上一集讨论的那次辞职一样。

sentences.en: It's like, you don't really want this to be the style of end.
sentences.zh: 就好像，你真的不希望这是结局的方式。

sentences.en: You want it to have a sort of democracy prevailing or something more dramatic.
sentences.zh: 你希望它能有一种民主的胜利，或者更戏剧化的场面。

sentences.en: But the fact that this sort of backroom deal of extremely powerful and wealthy people putting the end to his career is like, yeah, I'm glad it happened.
sentences.zh: 但这种由极其富有和有权势的人在幕后交易来终结他职业生涯的事实，让我觉得，好吧，我很高兴它发生了。

sentences.en: But this is not the way you want things to happen.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是你希望事情发生的方式。

sentences.en: It's just like a nastier form of government that's being represented here.
sentences.zh: 这只是这里所呈现的一种更卑劣的政府形式。

sentences.en: Yes, I feel like it is the sour taste that I get sometimes at the end of Godzilla movies.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得这就像我有时看完《哥斯拉》电影后那种苦涩的余味。

sentences.en: I love Godzilla movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢《哥斯拉》电影。

sentences.en: But when another monster comes along and then Godzilla fights that monster away and everyone's like, yeah, Godzilla.
sentences.zh: 但当另一只怪兽出现，哥斯拉将其击退，大家都在欢呼“哥斯拉万岁”时，

sentences.en: The implication is if that Godzilla, a monster who crushes people, was not there, that other monster would have killed everybody.
sentences.zh: 其潜台词是：如果那个会碾压人类的怪兽哥斯拉不在，那另一只怪兽就会杀光所有人。

sentences.en: We can't do this ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我们自己做不到。

sentences.en: We need a larger, scarier thing to take care of the scary thing.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一个更大、更可怕的东西来对付那个可怕的东西。

sentences.en: And that's a really – that's a terrible lesson to have about what's ostensibly a democracy where the whole point of the government is that the people can control their fates and control at least their governance.
sentences.zh: 这真是一个糟糕的教训，对于一个名义上的民主国家来说，政府存在的全部意义在于人民可以掌控自己的命运，至少可以掌控自己的治理。

sentences.en: Yeah, the idea that you need the richest,
sentences.zh: 是的，这种想法认为你需要全国，

sentences.en: most powerful man in the country potentially or in the state at least to knock out this other guy who was never elected and had his own power base is – it's very sad.
sentences.zh: 或者至少是全州最富有、最有权势的人来击倒这个从未当选且拥有自己权力基础的家伙，这真是太可悲了。

sentences.en: And so there's part of me that reads this and is like, yeah, you got him.
sentences.zh: 所以，我内心的一部分读到这里会想：没错，你抓到他了。

sentences.en: And there's another part of me that's like, oh, yeah, that's not – I wish like the people kind of like then went to the polls and voted Robert Moses out.
sentences.zh: 而另一部分则会想：哦，不，我真希望人们能去投票站把罗伯特·摩西投下去。

sentences.en: It's just not – it's not going to happen that way.
sentences.zh: 但这根本不会发生。

sentences.en: And what's clear is that – or what seems to have happened was that at some point the governor had promised Robert Moses a key part of this new MTA board,
sentences.zh: 显而易见的是——或者说似乎发生的情况是，州长在某个时候曾向罗伯特·摩西承诺过这个新MTA董事会的一个关键职位，

sentences.en: even though Ronan was going to be the head of the –
sentences.zh: 尽管罗南将成为该机构的负责人——

sentences.en: He'll be the head of it, but it's kind of unclear exactly what Moses thinks he's going to get,
sentences.zh: 他会是负责人，但摩西到底认为自己会得到什么并不清楚，

sentences.en: that he'll be either on the board and maybe can use his power base to outvote or push out Ronan,
sentences.zh: 他以为要么自己会进入董事会，并可能利用自己的权力基础来投票否决或排挤罗南，

sentences.en: or that he will be the president of this new kind of like super tri-bro that will happen inside of it.
sentences.zh: 要么他会成为这个新机构内部某种“超级三区管理局”的总裁。

sentences.en: And it's not really clear exactly what it is, but we know he's been promised something, and he doesn't get it.
sentences.zh: 具体是什么并不清楚，但我们知道他被承诺过什么，而他最终什么也没得到。

sentences.en: He doesn't get it all.
sentences.zh: 他什么都没得到。

sentences.en: And Carol says, Rockefeller's promise to Moses had served its purpose well.
sentences.zh: 卡罗说，洛克菲勒对摩西的承诺很好地达到了目的。

sentences.en: It had kept Moses quiet for almost a year, persuaded him not to oppose Rockefeller's transportation merger or the referendum which had funded it.
sentences.zh: 它让摩西保持沉默了近一年，说服他不要反对洛克菲勒的交通合并案或为其提供资金的公投。

sentences.en: The governor's promise had, moreover, persuaded Moses to withdraw the lawsuit which might have invalidated Rockefeller's transportation merger.
sentences.zh: 此外，州长的承诺还说服了摩西撤回了可能使洛克菲勒交通合并案失效的诉讼。

sentences.en: It had enabled Rockefeller to use his name.
sentences.zh: 它让洛克菲勒利用了他的名声。

sentences.en: And now, having used his name, having gotten everything out of him that he could, the governor threw him away.
sentences.zh: 现在，在利用了他的名声、榨干了他所有价值后，州长把他抛弃了。

sentences.en: And so Moses is now, by the time this is all done, he's 79 years old,
sentences.zh: 所以，当这一切结束时，摩西已经79岁了，

sentences.en: and he's just sitting around waiting for the moment when Rockefeller offers him what his new job is going to be.
sentences.zh: 他只是坐在那里，等待洛克菲勒告诉他新工作是什么。

sentences.en: And the merger deadline is coming, and he's hearing nothing.
sentences.zh: 合并的最后期限临近了，但他什么消息也没听到。

sentences.en: And the deadline is approaching when his tri-bro board that he controls just through votes, I guess that's it.
sentences.zh: 期限越来越近，他那个仅靠投票权控制的三区管理局董事会，我想就是这样了。

sentences.en: He's not really the – he's not the president of tri-bro.
sentences.zh: 他其实并不是三区管理局的总裁。

sentences.en: He's just the guy on the board who can control the most votes.
sentences.zh: 他只是董事会里那个能控制最多票数的人。

sentences.en: And I guess he's hoping maybe that he will have sole control of it or something like that.
sentences.zh: 我想他可能希望自己能拥有唯一的控制权之类的。

sentences.en: But anyway, that board that he controls is going to wink out of existence as soon as this merger happens.
sentences.zh: 但无论如何，一旦合并发生，他所控制的那个董事会就会瞬间消失。

sentences.en: And Moses' allies are calling the governor saying, you've got to give him something, got to give him something.
sentences.zh: 摩西的盟友们打电话给州长说：你得给他点什么，必须给他点什么。

sentences.en: And a day or two before the merger, Ronan finally calls Moses, and he goes, how did you like the job of consultant to the MTA?
sentences.zh: 在合并前一两天，罗南终于打电话给摩西，说：你觉得担任MTA顾问这份工作怎么样？

sentences.en: There's a $25,000 salary.
sentences.zh: 年薪2.5万美元。

sentences.en: You still get a limousine and a secretary, and there's no power attached to it whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 你依然有豪华轿车和秘书，但没有任何实权。

sentences.en: And Moses is insulted by this, but there's no other option.
sentences.zh: 摩西对此感到受辱，但别无选择。

sentences.en: It's either to take that or have nothing, just be pushed out of government.
sentences.zh: 要么接受这个，要么什么都没有，直接被踢出政府。

sentences.en: And so he accepts it.
sentences.zh: 所以他接受了。

sentences.en: He has nothing to fight with.
sentences.zh: 他已经没有任何筹码去抗争了。

sentences.en: He just accepts.
sentences.zh: 他只能接受。

sentences.en: And this is a part that feels kind of sad, but it's also kind of funny, but I don't know.
sentences.zh: 这一部分让人觉得有点悲哀，但也挺滑稽的，我不知道该怎么说。

sentences.en: Before the merger, Moses had been like, I am going to be a major player on this MTA board.
sentences.zh: 在合并之前，摩西还曾想：我将成为这个MTA董事会的重要角色。

sentences.en: So I'm going to invite the other future members of the board to lunch at Randall's Island.
sentences.zh: 所以我打算邀请董事会未来的其他成员到兰德尔岛共进午餐。

sentences.en: We're all going to get together.
sentences.zh: 我们要聚在一起。

sentences.en: I'll establish who I am.
sentences.zh: 我要确立我的地位。

sentences.en: You know, like I'll charm them.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像我要去征服他们一样。

sentences.en: But when the date comes for the lunch, which is he's planned it before the merger.
sentences.zh: 但当午餐日期到来时，他原本是在合并前计划的。

sentences.en: Now, the date is after.
sentences.zh: 现在，日期已经过了合并日。

sentences.en: When the date comes for the lunch, he's hosting a bunch of people who now run the MTA, and he has nothing to do with it.
sentences.zh: 当午餐日期到来时，他招待的是一群现在掌管MTA的人，而他与此毫无关系。

sentences.en: And he's out of power.
sentences.zh: 他已经失去了权力。

sentences.en: Ronan, his nemesis, is.
sentences.zh: 罗南，他的宿敌，才是掌权者。

sentences.en: And he's got to host them for lunch.
sentences.zh: 而他必须招待他们吃午饭。

sentences.en: And this guy who is used to venting his feelings, who is used to showing when he hates someone, is used to yelling at people,
sentences.zh: 这个习惯于发泄情绪、习惯于表现出对某人的厌恶、习惯于对人大吼大叫的家伙，

sentences.en: he knows if I'm ever going to be involved in construction in this state again, I've got to kiss Ronan's ass.
sentences.zh: 他知道如果我以后还想在这个州参与建设，我就必须去拍罗南的马屁。

sentences.en: I've got to eat whatever shit he pours into my mouth.
sentences.zh: 我必须吃下他塞进我嘴里的任何屎。

sentences.en: And I cannot – I just can't show him how I feel.
sentences.zh: 我不能——我就是不能让他看出我的感受。

sentences.en: And Carol says, the age of Moses was over, but gone on April 23rd, 1924.
sentences.zh: 卡罗说，摩西的时代结束了，不是在1924年4月23日结束的。

sentences.en: It had ended on March 1st, 1968.
sentences.zh: 它结束于1968年3月1日。

sentences.en: After 44 years of power, the power was gone at laSt.
sentences.zh: 在掌权44年后，权力终于消失了。

sentences.en: Gut punch.
sentences.zh: 沉重的一击。

sentences.en: At the end of chapter 49, we have one more chapter.
sentences.zh: 第49章结束了，我们还有最后一章。

sentences.en: It is chapter 50 titled Old after this.
sentences.zh: 那是第50章，标题是《老去》。

sentences.en: So chapter 50, final chapter, Old.
sentences.zh: 所以第50章，最后一章，《老去》。

sentences.en: This is –
sentences.zh: 这是——

sentences.en: From the chapter title, I assume he's going to make a comeback.
sentences.zh: 从章节标题来看，我以为他要东山再起了。

sentences.en: He's got a whole new – he's got a whole third act ahead of him, right?
sentences.zh: 他还有全新的——他还有整整第三幕在等着他，对吧？

sentences.en: And this is just kind of the falling action of the entire book, you know?
sentences.zh: 这只是整本书的收尾部分，你知道吗？

sentences.en: So, yeah, so we're at – Moses is, you know, around 80 years old.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我们现在——摩西大约80岁了。

sentences.en: He's been kicked out of the MTA.
sentences.zh: 他被踢出了MTA。

sentences.en: You know, it's hard to know where the public is with him at this point.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很难说此时公众对他是什么态度。

sentences.en: I think he's just pretty much forgotten.
sentences.zh: 我想他基本上已经被遗忘了。

sentences.en: He's pretty much – he's a guy who – I mean, I think ever since that when he resigned from the state posts and nobody really responded,
sentences.zh: 他基本上——我的意思是，我认为自从他辞去州政府职务且没人真正回应时起，

sentences.en: it's been clear that he is just not in the public imagination, the public consciousness the same way he once was.
sentences.zh: 很明显，他已经不再像过去那样存在于公众的想象和意识中了。

sentences.en: And even – this is – one of the things that I find fascinating about this chapter is that this is when Robert Caro starts entering the book in a different way
sentences.zh: 甚至——这是——我发现这一章最迷人的地方之一是，罗伯特·卡罗开始以一种不同的方式进入书中，

sentences.en: because this chapter overlaps with that short period when Moses was giving interviews to Caro and was talking to him.
sentences.zh: 因为这一章与摩西接受卡罗采访并与他交谈的那段短暂时期重叠了。

sentences.en: And so there are a couple of times in this where Caro talks much more directly about his experience of it.
sentences.zh: 所以书中几次提到卡罗更直接地谈论了他自己的经历。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, he's 80.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，他80岁了。

sentences.en: All of his allies are worried, what is he going to do with himself?
sentences.zh: 他所有的盟友都很担心，他自己该怎么办？

sentences.en: He still has this mind and he has nothing to do.
sentences.zh: 他依然头脑清醒，却无事可做。

sentences.en: And Caro just talks about going to see him, not knowing yet about him being pushed out of the MTA consideration, you know.
sentences.zh: 卡罗只是谈到去见他，当时还不知道他已经被排除在MTA考虑范围之外，你知道的。

sentences.en: And Caro says, there had been no official announcement that Moses had been utterly removed from power.
sentences.zh: 卡罗说，没有任何官方公告称摩西已被彻底剥夺权力。

sentences.en: The visitor did not know there had been so dramatic a change in the status of his hoSt.
sentences.zh: 访客并不知道他的主人地位发生了如此巨大的变化。

sentences.en: Of course, he never says I.
sentences.zh: 当然，他从不说“我”。

sentences.en: I'm the visitor.
sentences.zh: 我是那个访客。

sentences.en: He says the visitor, you know.
sentences.zh: 他说“访客”，你知道的。

sentences.en: But he saw it once that there had been dramatic change in the hoSt.
sentences.zh: 但他一旦看到，就知道主人的地位发生了巨大的变化。

sentences.en: He wrote on his notepad, the eyes are definitely more roomy today.
sentences.zh: 他在笔记本上写道：今天的眼神明显更加空洞了。

sentences.en: And he talks about this experience of, like, having to give Robert Moses a ride somewhere because Moses' chauffeur had been sent out on an errand.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了不得不开车送罗伯特·摩西去某处的经历，因为摩西的司机被派去办差了。

sentences.en: And so Caro has to, like, drive him in his car.
sentences.zh: 所以卡罗不得不开车送他。

sentences.en: And I remember reading this the first time and being like, oh, so not only did he meet him, but he, like, he had to drive him somewhere.
sentences.zh: 我记得第一次读到这里时心想：哦，所以他不仅见到了他，还不得不开车送他去某处。

sentences.en: And he says, as they walked down the steps of the cottage to the author's car, he's promoted himself to the author now from the visitor.
sentences.zh: 他说，当他们走下小屋的台阶走向作者的车时——他现在把自己从“访客”提升为“作者”了——

sentences.en: Moses did something that made him feel for an instant that the man walking behind him was not Robert Moses, but Paul.
sentences.zh: 摩西做了一个动作，让他瞬间觉得走在身后的人不是罗伯特·摩西，而是保罗。

sentences.en: The author had, unknown to Robert Moses, spent time with his dead brother.
sentences.zh: 作者在罗伯特·摩西不知情的情况下，曾与他死去的兄弟相处过。

sentences.en: Paul Moses had managed to keep his chin up even in discussing the misfortunes of his life, but sometimes drifting into reveries during lulls in the conversation.
sentences.zh: 保罗·摩西即使在谈论自己生活中的不幸时也能保持昂首挺胸，但有时在谈话的间隙会陷入沉思。

sentences.en: He had, unconsciously, it seemed, uttered a phrase, a sigh, almost a moan, that hinted at the depths of the melancholy within him, a painful, reflective sighing.
sentences.zh: 他似乎无意识地发出了一种短语，一声叹息，几乎是一声呻吟，暗示了他内心深处的忧郁，一种痛苦的、反思性的叹息。

sentences.en: Oh, ho, ho, ho.
sentences.zh: 哦，呵，呵，呵。

sentences.en: Oh, ho, ho, ho.
sentences.zh: 哦，呵，呵，呵。

sentences.en: The author had speculated that so unusual an expression might be inherited from their father.
sentences.zh: 作者推测这种不同寻常的表达方式可能是从他们父亲那里遗传下来的。

sentences.en: But in all the times he had previously talked with Robert Moses, the author had never heard him make that sound of discouragement and something close to despair.
sentences.zh: 但在之前所有与罗伯特·摩西的交谈中，作者从未听过他发出那种沮丧甚至接近绝望的声音。

sentences.en: But he made it now.
sentences.zh: 但他现在发出了。

sentences.en: I find that moment so touching and so beautifully written that Caro is, he's writing like a novelist there.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那一刻非常感人，写得太美了，卡罗在那里写得像个小说家。

sentences.en: He's tying together his experience with Moses' experience and revealing this, like, it's just, it's great.
sentences.zh: 他将自己的经历与摩西的经历联系在一起，揭示了这一点，这真是太棒了。

sentences.en: I mean, it's good story writing where you're like, you know that his relationship with Paul, because we've talked about it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是很好的故事写作，你知道他与保罗的关系，因为我们讨论过。

sentences.en: And you know that Paul to Robert Moses is failure to success, you know, like there,
sentences.zh: 你知道对于罗伯特·摩西来说，保罗代表着从失败到成功，你知道，就像那样，

sentences.en: that for Robert Moses to now sound like Paul Moses is such an indicator of how far he's fallen and how hopeless he is at this moment.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·摩西现在听起来像保罗·摩西，这充分说明了他跌落得有多深，此刻他有多么绝望。

sentences.en: I think it's just, it's such a beautiful passage.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这真是一个美丽的段落。

sentences.en: Robert Caro is a great writer.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·卡罗是一位伟大的作家。

sentences.en: I hate to, I hate to, that's the conclusion I'm coming to at the end, at the very end of the book.
sentences.zh: 我不想，我不想，这就是我在书的结尾得出的结论，在书的最末尾。

sentences.en: I wasn't so sure.
sentences.zh: 我之前还不确定。

sentences.en: He really, he really is.
sentences.zh: 他确实，他确实是。

sentences.en: Now I'm on board with his writing.
sentences.zh: 现在我完全被他的文笔折服了。

sentences.en: But what's, what's interesting, maybe what, you know, the, the source of that melancholy is that, you know, he had, he still has these ideas.
sentences.zh: 但有趣的是，也许那种忧郁的根源在于，你知道，他依然有这些想法。

sentences.en: This is, this is the time period where Robert Caro visits him.
sentences.zh: 这就是罗伯特·卡罗拜访他的那个时期。

sentences.en: He, you know, Robert Moses throws a handout and aid puts a map in his hand and he starts drawing on it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，罗伯特·摩西（Robert Moses）随手给出一份讲义，把地图塞到别人手里，然后就开始在上面画图。

sentences.en: He still looks at Fire Island and says, shouldn't there be a highway there?
sentences.zh: 他依然盯着火岛（Fire Island）看，说，那里难道不该修条高速公路吗？

sentences.en: You know, all that sort of stuff.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就是诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: He still had that stuff going, but he, you know, he's just desperate for Ronan to tap him to do something and no one is calling him up.
sentences.zh: 他依然在搞那一套，但他，你知道，他只是迫切地希望罗南（Ronan）能点名让他去做点什么，可没人找他。

sentences.en: And, and he has to be so obsequious, like his normal bluster, his normal, like sort of trying to control people with, with power and money.
sentences.zh: 而且，他不得不表现得极其卑躬屈膝，不像他平时那种虚张声势，那种试图用权力和金钱去控制人的样子。

sentences.en: None of that stuff is there anymore.
sentences.zh: 那些东西现在全都没了。

sentences.en: And he's just lost because he's never had to be, you know, get something from being kind, you know, like it's like a foreign language to him.
sentences.zh: 他感到迷茫，因为他从来不需要通过表现得友善来获得什么，你知道，这对他来说就像一门外语。

sentences.en: Like it's been 40 years since he has had, since he's been in a position of, yeah, needing something from someone and not being able to bully it out of them, basically.
sentences.zh: 距离他上一次处于那种需要从别人那里得到什么，却又无法通过霸凌手段强取豪夺的境地，已经过去40年了。

sentences.en: And they, and he's, I mean, he's experiencing also that I think I like that this chapter is called old because it's not just like fall of a Titan or something like this.
sentences.zh: 而且他，我是说，他也在经历这些，我觉得这一章叫“老去”很好，因为它不仅仅是关于泰坦巨人的陨落之类的。

sentences.en: He is experiencing something that all of us will probably experience at some point, just with a greater degree of deservedness, maybe.
sentences.zh: 他正在经历我们所有人可能都会在某个阶段经历的事情，只是也许他更“罪有应得”一点。

sentences.en: That of like, he's being cut out of things like the people at the MTA who used to work for him and now don't,
sentences.zh: 那就是他正被排除在圈子之外，比如那些曾经为他工作、现在却不再听命于他的大都会运输署（MTA）的人，

sentences.en: they have learned to not tell him what's going on at the MTA because he'll just send Ronan a memo about how he doesn't like it and Ronan will get annoyed.
sentences.zh: 他们已经学会了不告诉他MTA正在发生什么，因为他只会给罗南发备忘录抱怨，而罗南会因此感到恼火。

sentences.en: So he is being more and more cut out of even knowing what's going on.
sentences.zh: 所以他甚至连正在发生什么都越来越不知情了。

sentences.en: He wants to build that sound crossing bridge, the bridge that got Caro involved in this story in the first place.
sentences.zh: 他想建那座海峡大桥，就是当初让卡罗（Caro）卷入这个故事的那座桥。

sentences.en: And it keeps being delayed year after year for various reasons.
sentences.zh: 但它因为各种原因年复一年地被推迟。

sentences.en: And it eventually dawns on Moses, Rockefeller does want to build that bridge.
sentences.zh: 摩西最终意识到，洛克菲勒（Rockefeller）确实想建那座桥。

sentences.en: He does not want Moses to build it.
sentences.zh: 但他不想让摩西来建。

sentences.en: And they are waiting for him to either shuffle off into retirement or die.
sentences.zh: 他们都在等着他要么退休，要么死去。

sentences.en: Anyway, but his time is over and there's nothing you do about it.
sentences.zh: 总之，他的时代结束了，你对此无能为力。

sentences.en: And he starts pleading with his old power broker allies, like the union leaders, hey, can you get me something?
sentences.zh: 他开始恳求他那些老牌权力掮客盟友，比如工会领袖：嘿，能帮我弄点什么吗？

sentences.en: Can you put in a word to tell them to get me something?
sentences.zh: 能帮我美言几句，让他们给我安排点事做吗？

sentences.en: And the union leaders feel it's pathetic that he's coming to beg them for things.
sentences.zh: 而工会领袖们觉得他跑来乞求这些显得很可悲。

sentences.en: This used to be the guy who commanded and now he's begging.
sentences.zh: 这曾经是一个发号施令的人，现在却在乞求。

sentences.en: And they're like, all right, we'll try.
sentences.zh: 他们就说，好吧，我们试试。

sentences.en: And they lobby to try to get him control some projects, but it doesn't work.
sentences.zh: 他们游说试图让他掌控一些项目，但没用。

sentences.en: Nobody wants him and nobody needs him because he is, he doesn't have the power.
sentences.zh: 没人想要他，也没人需要他，因为他已经没有权力了。

sentences.en: It was not just his ability or his brilliance or his charisma that got him that success.
sentences.zh: 让他获得成功的不仅仅是他的能力、才华或魅力。

sentences.en: It was his ability to build power.
sentences.zh: 而是他建立权力的能力。

sentences.en: And once he has it, he's easy to dismiss.
sentences.zh: 一旦他失去了权力，他就很容易被抛弃。

sentences.en: And he's stuck just kind of publicly praising Ronan whenever he can, trying to get on his good side.
sentences.zh: 他只能困在原地，一有机会就公开赞美罗南，试图讨好他。

sentences.en: And there's this one detail Kara has where when he would launch into monologues at parties, because this is the 60s, even 81-year-old people are still going to parties.
sentences.zh: 卡罗书里有一个细节，当他在派对上开始滔滔不绝地独白时——因为那是60年代，连81岁的人都还在参加派对，

sentences.en: Everyone went to parties in the 60s.
sentences.zh: 60年代每个人都去派对。

sentences.en: And when he launches into monologues about his accomplishments, people used to sit up and listen because they had to.
sentences.zh: 当他开始长篇大论地讲述自己的成就时，人们过去会坐直了听，因为他们不得不听。

sentences.en: And now people are bored and they show him that they're bored.
sentences.zh: 而现在人们感到厌烦，并且直接表现出厌烦。

sentences.en: They don't want to listen to him anymore.
sentences.zh: 他们不想再听他说了。

sentences.en: And for a guy who thrilled to building and thrilled to the adulation of others, to have both of those taken away from him when he feels he still has so much to offer is really,
sentences.zh: 对于一个以建设为乐、以他人崇拜为乐的人来说，在觉得自己还有很多贡献可做的时候，这两样东西都被剥夺了，这真的……

sentences.en: I mean, you can sympathize with it without feeling it's really, without, well, seeing that it's totally earned and probably better.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你可以在不觉得这是他应得的、或者说不觉得这其实更好之前，对他产生同情。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's just and better for the world that he not have power, but still like you witness it and you're like,
sentences.zh: 是的，这只是……而且世界没有他掌握权力会更好，但你亲眼目睹这一切时，你会觉得……

sentences.en: you can still empathize with that type of feeling or sympathize at leaSt.
sentences.zh: 你依然可以对那种感觉产生共鸣，或者至少是同情。

sentences.en: Maybe not sympathize, maybe empathize.
sentences.zh: 也许不是同情，是共鸣。

sentences.en: Maybe you feel it a little bit.
sentences.zh: 也许你能感同身受一点点。

sentences.en: Yeah, empathize without sympathize, I think, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的，共鸣而不一定同情，我想是这样。

sentences.en: And he's 81 years old and he spends a lot of his time reading.
sentences.zh: 他当时81岁，花很多时间阅读。

sentences.en: So at this part of the chapter, I'm like, what a dream.
sentences.zh: 所以读到这一章时，我想，这简直是梦想生活。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，确实。

sentences.en: Like he's living in paradise.
sentences.zh: 就像生活在天堂一样。

sentences.en: He's just reading three books a day.
sentences.zh: 每天只读三本书。

sentences.en: It sounds fantastic.
sentences.zh: 听起来太棒了。

sentences.en: No one needs him for anything.
sentences.zh: 没人需要他做任何事。

sentences.en: One of the things that Caro gets into here, which I found pretty fascinating, is that, you know, the one thing that really, like he, A, he never took to and B,
sentences.zh: 卡罗在这里提到的一个让我觉得很着迷的点是，你知道，有一件事他真的，第一，他从没上手过，第二，

sentences.en: he was kind of a failure at was the public housing stuff.
sentences.zh: 他在公共住房方面其实是个失败者。

sentences.en: And so he comes up to this kind of unified public housing program where you would, this is extremely genius and novel.
sentences.zh: 所以他提出了这种统一的公共住房计划，这非常天才且新颖。

sentences.en: Why don't you build on land that isn't occupied by a bunch of people and throwing them out?
sentences.zh: 为什么不在没被一群人占据的土地上盖房子，非要把他们赶走呢？

sentences.en: And then you build that and you fill that up and then you take another area where those people have been moved out of or another vacant area and then you fill that up.
sentences.zh: 然后你建好房子，填满住户，再去处理那些人被迁走后的区域或其他空地，再填满它们。

sentences.en: So you do you create housing without destroying people's lives.
sentences.zh: 这样你就能在不摧毁人们生活的情况下创造住房。

sentences.en: And this is, of course, is like exhibited as a kind of genius move.
sentences.zh: 这当然被展示为一种天才之举。

sentences.en: But maybe it is for someone who doesn't feel for people.
sentences.zh: 但也许对于一个不体恤他人的人来说，这确实是。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, at the very least that he is.
sentences.zh: 嗯，至少他确实是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But that he is.
sentences.zh: 但他确实是。

sentences.en: He has a plan now, whereas before he was too busy to ever think about it.
sentences.zh: 他现在有了计划，而以前他太忙了，根本没空去想这些。

sentences.en: And Carol points out the flaws in the plan,
sentences.zh: 卡罗指出了这个计划的缺陷，

sentences.en: like there's there's no consideration of how much the city will have to create the services to support these areas that didn't have housing and that maybe the people that he would be moving in there don't necessarily want to live in the unused kind of distant parts of the city.
sentences.zh: 比如没有考虑到城市需要投入多少成本来为这些原本没有住房的区域提供配套服务，而且他想迁入的人未必想住在城市里那些未被利用的偏远地区。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But he feels like he has this he has this plan now and he's excited about it.
sentences.zh: 但他觉得他现在有了这个计划，并且为此感到兴奋。

sentences.en: But no one is interested.
sentences.zh: 但没人感兴趣。

sentences.en: And he still has these dreams of finishing that road along the shore that would that would have his Fire Island Highway in it.
sentences.zh: 他依然梦想着完成那条沿着海岸的道路，那条本该包含他火岛高速公路的道路。

sentences.en: Like he still dreams about this enormous park in Jamaica Bay, like that there's all this land that could still be used up for parks.
sentences.zh: 他依然梦想着牙买加湾（Jamaica Bay）那个巨大的公园，觉得还有那么多土地可以用来建公园。

sentences.en: He has this big map in his office that's got all the things he built on it, but it also all the things he didn't get to build on them.
